title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

Your Role

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
  • Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
  • Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
  • Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
  • Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.
Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
  • Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
  • Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
  • Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
  • Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.
Commercial and Customer Support
  • Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
  • Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
  • Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
  • Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.
Product Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
  • Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
  • Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
  • Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.
Your Profile

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with product ownership, commercial awareness and an interest in working across the organization.

You bring:

  • A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering, process technology, production engineering or a comparable field.
  • Experience with product ownership, product development, mechanical engineering or technical project execution within industrial machinery or a related industry.
  • A good understanding of mechanical equipment, machine interfaces and the interaction between mechanics and automation.
  • Experience with hygienic equipment, food production or filling and dosing technology is an advantage.
  • The ability to understand customer applications and translate technical and commercial needs into product requirements and practical solutions.
  • A structured approach to product roadmaps, technical decisions, documentation and follow-up.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions influence customer value, project performance and lifecycle cost.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable engineering and ERP systems would be an advantage.

Above all, you are curious about how products perform in real customer environments. You enjoy developing technical knowledge, asking questions and bringing people together around solutions that work across the full value chain.

What We Offer
  • A central role with genuine influence on the future direction of Gram Equipment’s filling portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
  • The opportunity to combine technology, customer insight, commercial understanding and product development.
  • Close cooperation with experienced specialists across Engineering, Automation, Sales, Production, Projects and Service.
  • An international working environment with customers and colleagues across global markets.
  • Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
  • An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
  • Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.

The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.

Apply Now

Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

As an employee at REMA Distribution, you will become part of a company that aims to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices. Responsibilities

You will become part of a dedicated and interdisciplinary team that values high professional standards, education, and good cooperation.Anesthesia Department 2We are organized into two specialty-based teams, with a focus on maintaining specialty-specific competencies while also helping one another across teams to create flexibility and variety in everyday work. We are looking for colleagues who are interested in both teams, but please mention any preference in your application.Team A:Handles anesthesia for abdominal surgery, ECT treatment, and interventional procedures (e.g., PTC and Coiling). title: CNC Machinist at MC Uldall – Work with Advanced CNC Turning in Stainless Steel

CNC Machinist – Advanced Turning of Stainless Steel

No application or CV required - Danish optional!

Would you like to work with complex components, modern Okuma machines and a high degree of freedom in your daily work?

At MC Uldall Maskinfabrik, we are looking for a skilled CNC machinist to join our turning department in Skanderborg, Denmark.

We manufacture high-precision components for industries including food processing, pharmaceuticals and offshore. Our customers have high expectations when it comes to quality, documentation and surface finish. We are therefore looking for a colleague who takes pride in their craftsmanship and enjoys finding the right technical solutions.

What we offer

  • A strong team of experienced CNC machinists and machine operators

  • Flexible working hours, with start times between 5:30 and 8:00 a.m.

  • Opportunities for professional development and responsibility

title: Mechanical Project Engineer - FEM/FEA
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!  We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc.  Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops.  Key tasks and responsibilities:     Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor     FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal  pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support.     Hand calculations     Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations     Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others     Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices     DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT     Review 3D designs and 2D drawings     Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking     Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1  Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.   Who are you You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.  What you know We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly.  Requirements:     Degree in Mechanical Engineering     Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions.     Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity.     Excellent communication skills in English   For more information, please contact Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  #LI-CL1

title: Postdoctoral Position in Intelligent Computing Architectures
description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a one-year postdoctoral researcher position within Intelligent Computing Architectures, focusing on Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning. The appointment runs for one year from March 1, 2027, with the possibility of extension subject to available funding.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to design, optimize, and evaluate hybrid quantum-classical learning systems under realistic hardware constraints. The project is platform-independent and will investigate how noise, limited quantum resources, device connectivity, and classical computational overhead affect learning performance and practical implementation.

Possible research directions include hardware-aware model design and training, quantum-classical ensemble learning and mixture-of-experts, resource-efficient learning methods, and automated architecture search. The specific research programme will be defined with the successful applicant according to their expertise and the project objectives, with a focused and achievable scope for the initial year. Evaluation will include suitable classical baselines and explicit assessment of computational resource requirements.

The successful candidate will work on model design, quantum programming, simulation, training, and experimental evaluation of hybrid quantum-classical learning systems. The position includes collaboration with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners, identifying relevant research and implementation opportunities, and supporting joint activities. The candidate will also contribute to research proposals and funding applications related to quantum machine learning, intelligent computing architectures, and resource-efficient computing, as well as publications, technical documentation, and project reporting. The research will be supervised by Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio.

 

As a Postdoc in Hardware-Aware Quantum Machine Learning, your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Design, implement, and simulate hybrid quantum-classical learning models, investigating the effects of noise, connectivity, finite sampling, resource limitations, and training conditions. Explore suitable methods such as hardware-aware training, ensemble learning, mixture-of-experts, or architecture search within the agreed research program.

  • Conduct reproducible experimental evaluations of learning performance, trainability, noise resilience, and computational resource requirements using quantum programming frameworks and machine learning tools. Compare results with suitable classical baselines and correlate observed behavior with model design and hardware constraints.

  • Support collaboration with Danish and international academic, industrial, and technology-development partners in quantum machine learning and intelligent computing architectures, identify relevant research and implementation opportunities, contribute to joint activities, and prepare research proposals, funding applications, publications, technical documentation, and project reports.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • An opportunity to develop a platform-independent research program in hardware-aware quantum machine learning, combining quantum programming, simulation, and machine learning methods with resource-aware evaluation.

  • Opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in quantum machine learning, microelectronics, AI accelerators, and advanced computing.

  • Strong support for professional development through the Lecturer Training Programme and mentoring, as well as opportunities to develop experience in research proposal writing, project development, and collaboration with Danish and European technology partners. 

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, computing architectures, quantum computing, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Quantum Computing, Machine Learning, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Demonstrated experience in quantum programming using frameworks such as Qiskit, PennyLane, or equivalent tools, including implementation and simulation of quantum circuits.

  • Demonstrated experience in machine learning, including model implementation, training, and evaluation, with strong programming skills. Experience in quantum machine learning, hybrid quantum-classical models, noise-aware optimization, ensemble methods, or automated architecture search is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. The postdoc will work with Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio on hardware-aware quantum machine learning, with opportunities to connect this research to the section’s expertise in AI accelerators and energy-efficient computing architectures.

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the research and the position, please contact Assistant Professor Alberto Marchisio (chisio@sdu.dk), research contact and supervisor. Additional enquiries may be directed to Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is December 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial one-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 1, 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Research Assistant in Learning Design
description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a Research Assistant position. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from March 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is for 12 months.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This position sits where those ideas become things people can actually use. You will take responsibility for designing and creating content — reusable set of pedagogical modules that instructors can adopt without redesigning a whole course — and for the hands-on work of redesigning selected software engineering courses at SDU. The project’s research produces findings; this role turns them into activities, materials, rubrics, and guidance that survive contact with a real semester. Implementation is iterative rather than one-shot. Modules go into classrooms, evidence comes back through classroom interventions, surveys, artifact analysis, and educator feedback, and the next version is better for it. If you like building educational material and watching it improve under real use — and you would rather serve teaching than only write about it — this is a role with unusually visible results. Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and produce reusable pedagogical modules — guided scenarios, reflection and verification activities, assessment tasks, rubrics, and instructor guidance — that courses can adopt on demand.

  • Redesign selected SE courses at SDU. Work with course responsibles and programme leaders to rework intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment so that responsible AI use is explicitly taught and examined.

  • Coordinate classroom deployments across semesters, keeping instructors supported and the logistics from eating the pedagogy.

  • Gather and act on evidence. Administer surveys, analyze student artifacts (decision notes, verification evidence, reflections), collect structured educator feedback, and feed it into the next iteration.

  • Document and release. Maintain the toolkit as open, well-documented material others can pick up after the project ends, and contribute to project reporting and publications.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree, on Game Development and Learning Technology, Design and Interaction, Educational Technology, Media and Communication, or a closely related field. The degree must be completed before the starting date — this is a firm requirement.

Qualifications Required

  • Demonstrated experience creating educational content — course materials, learning modules, exercises, assessment tasks, e-learning components, or training programmes — with examples you can show us. Please, share a link to your portfolio if available.

  • An educational or pedagogical background, whether through your degree, formal training in teaching or learning design, or substantial practical experience.

  • Excellent written and spoken Danish and English, and the ability to write clearly for two audiences at once: students and the instructors who will use your materials.

Personal competences

  • Craft in making things others will use. You care whether an activity actually works in week seven of a busy semester, not only whether it reads well in a design document.

  • A service orientation towards instructors. Course responsibles own their courses and have limited time. We value someone who makes adoption easy and earns agreement through evidence and patience rather than argument.

  • Organized and self-directed. You will be coordinating deployments across courses at SDU and several semesters, and much of the scheduling discipline will rest with you.

  • Comfort with iteration. The first version of a module will be wrong in interesting ways. Treating that as information rather than failure is most of the job.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be collecting data from people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

 

Workplace description 

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • Up to two references (can be supplied later in the hiring process).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment termsAppointment as a research assistant is temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from March 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

title: Postdoc and Assistant Professor Positions in Communications, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design
description:
Would you like to advance wireless connectivity and radar sensing for intelligent devices and autonomous systems? The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one or more Postdoc (2 years) and/or Assistant Professor positions in Communications, Signal Processing, Radar Systems, and Antenna Design. Join a growing research environment connecting electronic systems research with applications in robotics, drones, defence technology, and the Internet of Things (IoT). The preferred starting date is February 1, 2027.

 

Job Content

Your research will advance communications, signal processing, radar systems, and antenna design, with a focus on real-time wireless connectivity, physical-layer technologies, and antennas for intelligent devices, IoT systems, and edge computers. The scope spans 5G, mmWave, terahertz technologies, 6G and beyond, LoRa, software-defined radio, and integrated sensing, including communication protocols, modulation techniques, and antenna design and implementation. Applications include autonomous collaborative robotics, drone swarm communications, radar-based object detection and tracking, low-power radio sensor networks, and defence technology.

You will have the opportunity to connect your research with the section’s complementary expertise in FPGA and neuromorphic computing, edge AI, machine learning, sensing technologies, and energy harvesting. Working with academic colleagues and professional staff across SDU campuses, you will contribute to a collaborative research community and the development of academic programmes.

Postdoc: You will conduct research within the position’s scope, contribute to course planning, support teaching, and supervise Bachelor’s and Master’s students in relevant fields. You will also support the research team in developing applications for external funding.

Assistant Professor: You will develop and sustain a research agenda that strengthens or complements the section’s activities, secure external research funding, and publish in reputable journals and international conference proceedings. You will plan and teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses in communications, radar and sensor technologies, and antenna theory and practice, while advising and mentoring students and supervising their research projects. You will also contribute to academic service at section and department levels, participate in professional activities and conferences locally, nationally, and internationally, and undertake other duties assigned by the Section Chair.

 

Required Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD degree in Electronics, Communications, or a closely related field. Your application must document the following qualifications:

  • Research expertise relevant to the position in communications, signal processing, or antenna design.

  • Demonstrated potential to teach Bachelor’s and Master’s-level courses at university level.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants, pedagogical and subject-specific skills appropriate to the position’s teaching and research responsibilities.

International research experience gained in an environment other than the institution where the applicant completed their PhD will be considered an advantage. 

 

Workplace description 

The section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics brings together research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communications. Using advanced reconfigurable computing and sensing technologies, we develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions for autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grids, and healthcare. This breadth creates opportunities to connect fundamental research with practical engineering challenges. 

Our research is organized into four complementary areas: 1) Infrastructure Inspection and Maintenance, 2) Bio-inspired Intelligent Systems, 3) High-Frequency Power Management, and 4) Radar Remote Sensing. The section is growing steadily and comprises 15 staff members, including professors, PhD students, and engineers, who contribute to research, industrial collaboration, and education. We play a central role in electrical engineering education in Odense, contributing to Bachelor’s and Master of Science programmes in Electronics Engineering. 

SDU’s Odense campus brings together six faculties, with a large university hospital soon to join the campus environment, creating opportunities for interdisciplinary research and a vibrant student life. Odense offers a culturally rich setting with a growing robotics community, attractive residential areas, and green spaces along the river through the city centre. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU.

 

Further information 

To learn more about the positions and research environment, please contact Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, Head of the Section of Digital and High-Frequency Electronics, at esme@sdu.dk. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

We welcome applications outlining how your expertise and research ambitions would contribute to the section. Please submit your application in English and include the following documents: 

  • A motivation letter describing your interest in the position, relevant qualifications, and reasons for joining the section (maximum 2 pages).

  • A detailed curriculum vitae, including contact information, research experience, teaching experience, computational skills, and other relevant qualifications.

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a Teaching Portfolio documenting your teaching qualifications and experience. 

  • For Assistant Professor applicants: a research plan outlining your proposed research direction and plans for developing a research line, securing external funding, and building a research team. 

  • For Postdoc applicants: a brief research plan outlining your proposed research focus, approach, and expected contributions during the two-year appointment, including its alignment with the position and the section’s activities. 

  • PhD, Master’s and     Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent (original     and an official English translation). 

  • A list of publications, with the most relevant     publications highlighted.  

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Names and email addresses of up to three     researchers who can provide an informed reference at short notice.     Reference letters and documentation of other relevant qualifications may     also be included.  

  • A statement/documentation     of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is December 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

The appointments are temporary for an initial 2-year period (for the postdoc position) or 3-year period (for the assistant professor position). Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme.  

Employment as a postdoctoral fellow and assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for either postdoc or assistant professor as described therein.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

description:
Tööülesanded: El Castillo OÜ arendab ja haldab üürikinnisvara Tallinnas. Otsime inimest, kes aitaks hoida meie üürimajad korras ning korraldada igapäevast suhtlust üürnike ja hoolduspartneritega. title: Puhastustööde juht
description:
Tööülesanded: Korraldad sise- ja tootmisruumide igapäevast koristust ning eripuhastustöid. Juhid 35-liikmelist meeskonda: osaled töötajate värbamises, juhendad ja koolitad töötajaid, koostad töögraafikuid ning korraldad asendusi. Kontrollid isiklikult objektidel töö kvaliteeti ja ohutusnõuete järgimist, selgitad välja puuduste põhjused ning tagad nende kõrvaldamise. Arvutad Excelis tööajanorme, töömahte, personali- ja materjalivajadust ning teenuste omahinda ja maksumust. Analüüsid kulusid ja ressursside kasutamise tõhusust. Suhtled klientidega, koostad ja põhjendad hinnapakkumisi, lepid kokku töökorralduslikke muudatusi ning lahendad igapäevaseid küsimusi ja pretensioone. Planeerid ja korraldad tööd nii, et teenuse kvaliteet oleks tagatud ning personali, tööaja ja materjalide kasutamine oleks tõhus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Stabiilset tööd BLRT Grupi ettevõttes. Iseseisvust töö korraldamisel ja võimalust oma teadmisi rakendada. Administratiivset tuge ostude, arvestuse ja dokumentatsiooni korraldamisel. Isikliku auto kasutamise hüvitist tööalaste sõitude eest. Kaasaegseid ja ergonoomilisi töövahendeid. BLRT Grupi töötajate tunnustamise poliitikas määratletud soodustusi. Tööpiirkond: Tallinn ja Maardu. Tööaeg: täistööaeg, paindlik tööajagraafik.

Muud nõuded: Kehtiv Puhastustööde juht, tase 5 kutsetunnistus. Puhastustööde korraldamise ja meeskonna juhtimise kogemus, vähemalt 3 aastat. Puhastustehnoloogiate, töömeetodite ja kvaliteedinõuete hea tundmine, sealhulgas tootmisruumide koristamise eripärade mõistmine. Hea Exceli kasutamise oskus: valemid, arvutused, liigendtabelid, tööaja ja kulude arvestus ning andmete analüüs. Hea arvutikasutamise oskus: MS Wordi ja Outlooki kindel kasutamine ning oskus töötada ettevõtte infosüsteemides ja koostada tööalast dokumentatsiooni. Analüütiline mõtlemine, iseseisev otsustusvõime, hea organiseerimisoskus ja vastutustunne. Oskus töötajaid juhendada ja õpetada, klientidega professionaalselt suhelda ning probleeme lahendada. Eesti ja vene keele oskus iseseisvaks tööalaseks suhtlemiseks ja dokumentidega töötamiseks, vähemalt B2-tasemel.

title: Noorem ostuspetsialist
description:
Tööülesanded: Sinu peamiseks ülesandeks on toetada ettevõtte tarneahela sujuvat toimimist. Igapäevaselt suhtled tarnijate ja alltöövõtjatega, pead hinnaläbirääkimisi ning sõlmid kokkuleppeid, et tagada tootmiseks vajalike materjalide, komponentide, pooltoodete ja alltöövõtuteenuste õigeaegne olemasolu. Teed ostutellimusi, sisestad tarnijatelt saadud pakkumised ja hinnainfo kalkulatsioonitabelitesse ning jälgid tellimuste täitmist ja kokkulepitud tarnetähtaegadest kinnipidamist. Töötad tihedas koostöös tootmise ja teiste kolleegidega, et ostuprotsessid kulgeksid sujuvalt ning ettevõtte eesmärgid saaksid täidetud.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meid juhib soov anda inimestele vabadus teha asju, mida nad päriselt teha tahavad – asju, mis loovad uut väärtust. Teeme seda, luues tehastele nutikaid automatiseerimislahendusi ja aidates ettevõtetel tuua turule uued targad masinad. Keskmise suurusega ettevõttena saame tegutseda kiiresti ja paindlikult, teha otsuseid operatiivselt ning reageerida klientide vajadustele. Väljakutsuvad projektid: lähtume iga kliendi ainulaadsetest vajadustest ja loome just neile sobiva lahenduse. Kogenud meeskond: hindame üksteise kogemusi, jagame oma teadmisi ja toetame üksteist igapäevases töös. Arenemisvõimalus: meie juures saad alustada nooremspetsialistina, arendada oma oskusi ja kasvada kogemuste lisandudes vanemspetsialistiks või oma valdkonna eksperdiks. Toetame sinu arengut ning anname võimaluse liikuda samm-sammult suurema vastutuse ja uute väljakutsete poole. Kiirus ja paindlikkus: keskmise suurusega ettevõttena suudame otsuseid teha kiiresti ja viia head ideed kiiresti tootmisesse. Hoiak: teeme ära. Armastame väljakutseid ja anname igas projektis endast parima – poolikuid lahendusi me ei tee.

Muud nõuded: Oled täpne, süsteemne ja hea suhtleja, kellele meeldib leida lahendusi ning teha koostööd nii tarnijate, alltöövõtjate kui ka kolleegidega. Sul on huvi tehnilise valdkonna vastu ning soov õppida tundma ostuprotsesse ja tarneahela toimimist. Oled julge suhtleja, avatud uutele väljakutsetele ning valmis arendama oma oskusi läbirääkimiste pidamisel ja koostöösuhete loomisel. Tunned end kindlalt arvutiga töötades ning valdad väga hästi eesti ja inglise keelt nii kõnes kui ka kirjas. Sul on vähemalt keskeriharidus, eelistatult tehnilise suunitlusega. Kasuks tuleb tehniliste jooniste lugemise oskus ning varasem töökogemus ostuspetsialisti, tehnoloogi või mõnes muus tehnilises rollis tootmisettevõttes, kuid kõige olulisemad on sinu huvi, õppimisvalmidus ja soov areneda.

Koduhooldustöötaja

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

title: Digital Growth Marketing Manager
description: _Fastems is a global partner for machining manufacturers, delivering intelligent automation for cutting machine tools and surrounding processes. We are a family-owned business with 40 years of automation experience, over 5000 installations and main markets in Europe, North America and Asia. Our mission is to help metalworking manufacturers improve their productivity and profitability. Globally, there are already 450 of us learning, growing and prospering together. At Fastems you get to work with some of the brightest people in the industry, so every day is an opportunity to learn something new._We are looking for a **Digital Growth Marketing Manager** to join our global marketing team and drive growth through digital channels. You will own our growth marketing engine and keep optimizing and improving it based on data and AI. We are looking for someone who really loves digital marketing, has a proactive working style, and thinks systematically and creatively. You bring a positive attitude, a collaborative mindset and a good sense of humour. A little spark in your eyes doesnt hurt either.**What will you get to work on?****Marketing automation & CRM**You will own and continuously develop our lead pipeline in Salesforce Sales Cloud, helping marketing and sales work smoothly together. You will also support localized prospecting activities and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing and customer engagement journeys across Marketing Cloud and Service Cloud.**Website, SEO & GEO**You will take ownership of our new website (which will be published soon) built on WordPress, and develop it further with our web partner. Your focus is SEO and GEO visibility, digital customer journeys, conversion and analytics – ensuring a site that drives engagement.**Growth marketing**You will drive demand generation through LinkedIn, Meta, SEO/GEO, SEM, and other digital channels. You create, run, measure and optimize campaigns based on collected data. The target is qualified demand and a real contribution to sales, not just traffic.**Marketing AI**You will lead the development of our marketing AI strategy and turn promising ideas into practical solutions. You will identify where AI creates business value, help define the required data, technologies and integrations, and work with partners to make it happen. Quality, security and human oversight remain important throughout.**Analytics & performance**You will build visibility across the marketing and sales funnel. Your insights will help us understand what creates qualified demand, what converts, what needs improvement and where we should invest next.**Who will you work with?**You will have a lot of ownership, but you are not on your own. You work closely with colleagues in marketing, sales, product management, and with external partners. You are in charge of digital strategy and implementation, working closely with your teammates who lead content creation.**What will you bring with you?**- A hands-on digital marketing enthusiast who thinks systemically, enjoys working with data and technology and wants to understand what really drives business results - Strategic and analytical person who can both plan and execute - Curiosity about AI, marketing technology and new ways of working - with business value first in mind - Good project management and teamwork skills - Proactive and independent way of working - 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, MarTech or a similar role - Fluent in English and at least basic Finnish skills for everyday workplace - Experience in international B2B marketing of technically complex products, manufacturing or industrial automation is a plus **Location and ways of working**Our office is located in **Lahdesjärvi, Tampere**. We offer flexible hybrid working and the possibility to work partly remotely. However, this role also requires regular on-site presence in Tampere to support close collaboration with the team and key stakeholders.**We can offer you:**- A key role in shaping digital growth at a global industrial automation company. - Fastems strong company culture expressed through our values. - Career and development opportunities. - International work atmosphere and global activities. - Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely. - Comprehensive employee benefits, such as culture and lunch benefit at the office. **Interested in joining #fastemsians?**For more information about the position and the recruitment process, please contact:Teemu-Pekka Ahonen / Head of Product Management & Marketing: teemu.ahonen@fastems.comSend your application together with your CV and salary request **by November 29th at the latest.** Please note that even though the application deadline is not reached, we may proceed with interviews and make a hire as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö, Rue Madame, Helsinki
description: Rue Madamessa ihmiset ovat kaiken keskiössä. Uskomme, että juuri ihmiset luovat ravintolan sielun. Rakennamme työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä, onnistua ja tuntea olevansa tärkeä osa porukkaa.Etsimme nyt Rue Madamen tiimiin osaavaa ja lämminhenkistä apulaisravintolapäällikköä.Apulaisravintolapäällikön roolissa varmistat ravintolan arjen sujuvuuden. Johdat, perehdytät ja valmennat henkilöstöä sekä osallistut itse aktiivisesti salityöskentelyyn. Toimit ravintolapäällikön läheisenä työparina palvelukulttuurin, asiakaskokemuksen, myynnin ja kannattavuuden kehittämiseksi.Viinit ovat tärkeä osa vastuutasi: suunnittelet, kehität ja ylläpidät viinimenua yhdessä ravintolapäällikön kanssa. Tuot osaamisesi asiakkaiden iloksi, myynnin tueksi ja tiimin viinituntemuksen vahvistamiseksi.Tarjoamme sinulle- Kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen Rue Madamen kirjoilla- Vastuullisen ja käytännönläheisen roolin ravintolapäällikön työparina- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ravintolan toimintaan ja viinivalikoimaan- Työyhteisön, jossa ihmiset ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat etusijalla- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan (palkkahaitari 2 800-3 700 €) kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi huomioiden- Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut (mm. työterveyshuolto, ePassi flex, alennuksia Reloven ja Rue Madamen tuotteista itselle ja pöytäseurueelle)Odotamme sinulta- Pitkää ja monipuolista ravintola-alan kokemusta sekä aiempaa esihenkilökokemusta- Vahvaa viinituntemusta ja halukkuutta hyödyntää sitä käytännössä (sommelierin koulutus katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ei ole edellytys)- Empaattista ja jämäkkää johtamista, jolla luot ympärillesi vakautta ja hyvää energiaa- Oma-aloitteisuutta, kehittämismyönteisyyttä ja aitoa intoa ravintola-alaa kohtaanTehtävä edellyttää lisäksi- Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa (suomen kielen osaaminen on etu, ei vaatimus)- Hygienia- ja anniskelupassia sekä terveydentilan selvitystä salmonellatartunnasta- Valmiutta työskennellä aamu- ja iltavuoroissa maanantaista sunnuntaihin ravintolan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti (klo 08-24 välillä)Kuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi? Jos haluat yhdistää ihmisten johtamisen, viiniosaamisen ja ravintolan arjessa tekemisen, haluamme kuulla sinusta hakemuksen muodossa! Lähetä tietosi meille mahdollisimman pian, sillä tehtävä täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia. Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla.***Assistant Restaurant Manager, Rue Madame, HelsinkiAt Rue Madame, people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that people are what give a restaurant its soul. We are building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, succeed and feel like a valued part of the team.We are looking for a skilled and warm-hearted Assistant Restaurant Manager to join the Rue Madame team.As Assistant Restaurant Manager, you will ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the restaurant. You will lead, onboard and coach the team while actively working on the restaurant floor yourself. You will work closely with the Restaurant Manager to develop our service culture, customer experience, sales and profitability.Wine will be an important part of your responsibilities: you will plan, develop and maintain the wine list together with the Restaurant Manager. You will use your expertise to delight our guests, support sales and strengthen the teams wine knowledge.What we offer- A full-time, permanent position employed directly by Rue Madame- A hands-on role with responsibility, working closely with the Restaurant Manager- The opportunity to influence the restaurants operations and wine selection- A workplace where people and shared success come first- A fixed monthly salary (€2,800-€3,700), based on your experience and skills- A wide range of employee benefits (including occupational healthcare, ePassi Flex, and discounts on Relove and Rue Madame products for you and your dining party)What we expect from you- Extensive and varied experience in the restaurant industry, along with previous supervisory experience- Strong wine knowledge and a willingness to put it into practice (sommelier training is an advantage but not a requirement)- An empathetic yet firm leadership style that creates stability and positive energy around you- Initiative, an openness to development and a genuine passion for the restaurant industryThe role also requires- Fluent English (Finnish language skills are an advantage, not a requirement)- A hygiene passport, an alcohol passport and a health certificate regarding salmonella infection- Availability to work morning and evening shifts from Monday to Sunday, in line with the restaurants opening hours (between 08:00 and 24:00)Could this be your next step? If you want to combine people leadership, wine expertise and hands-on work in the day-to-day running of a restaurant, we would love to receive your application! Submit your application as soon as possible, as the position will be filled once a suitable candidate is found.Please apply using the application form, as we cannot consider applications submitted by email for data security reasons. To apply for open positions, you need to create a jobseeker profile on Barona Careers. You only need to complete your profile once, after which you can use it to apply for any Barona vacancy.

title: FA Solutions: Solution Consultant (Fintech SaaS, Riga or Helsinki)
description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki / Riga**Application deadline:** 29.11.2026Are you passionate about finance, technology and helping clients succeed? Join FA Solutions growing team as a **Solution Consultant** and turn complex business needs into practical solutions!FA Solutions is a market leading provider of software for Asset & Wealth Managers, helping them manage their investments globally. The company offers a cloud-based Portfolio Management solution that automates and centralizes a wide range of operational processes into one easy-to-use FA Platform.FA Solutions is committed to delivering a robust and scalable solution that prioritises user experience, data security, and compliance, allowing the client companies to leverage the power of open architecture and interoperability.**What will you be doing?**As a Solution Consultant, you will play a central role in helping FAs new clients to start running their business on FA platform and to help FAs existing clients to get the most out of the FA system capabilities.The role combines project management, investment management knowledge and technical problem-solving, with a strong emphasis on client relationships and delivering business value.**Your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle:**- Taking ownership of designing new client-specific solutions by mapping business requirements with the platforms capabilities and best practices - Configuring and customizing the platform to meet client needs, including light scripting and data migration - Coordinating implementation projects, communicating progress, and ensuring delivery quality - Conducting workshops and training sessions for client users - Contributing to improvement projects for existing clients, from gap analysis to delivery You'll collaborate closely with account management, product management, customer support and delivery partners, while maintaining an active dialogue with clients throughout the projects.You will manage several long-term projects simultaneously and work closely with clients, particularly in the UK and Iceland.**What makes you a great fit?**You will work with various stakeholders and clients, which highlights the importance of excellent communication and collaboration skills. As your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle, you'll also need basic project management skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to deliver training sessions and host workshops.You might be the talent we are looking for if you enjoy bringing people, processes and technology together. You can confidently lead client discussions, structure complex requirements and keep projects moving forward. You are curious about how financial businesses operate and motivated to learn new software solutions. You do not need to be a programmer to succeed in this role.**We require you to have:**- Minimum 2 years of experience in consulting, software implementation, professional services or client-facing project delivery - Good understanding of financial services or investment management, or a strong interest in developing your expertise in the field - A genuine interest in working with clients and the ability to succeed in a customer-facing environment - Experience coordinating projects, managing stakeholders and translating business requirements into practical solutions - A full professional proficiency and presentation skills in English **We consider as an asset:**- Experience in investment management industry - Knowledge of Agile and Waterfall project methodologies - Experience with Jira or similar project management tools - Some experience in scripting (Java, JavaScript, SQL or similar) **FA Solutions offers you:**- The opportunity to own meaningful client projects and see how your work improves financial institutions' everyday operations - A collaborative international team where you can learn from experienced colleagues and work with clients across different markets - Room to grow into a senior consulting, team leadership or specialist role as your expertise develops - The flexibility and speed of a startup, backed by the resources and stability of an established company - Flexible working hours and remote work policy - Auntie well-being service, occupational health care in Finland, health insurance in Latvia - Bonus model **Practicalities:**This is a full-time and permanent position, in which you will be employed directly to FA Solutions.You will join the Professional Services team either in **Helsinki, Finland,** or **Riga, Latvia**, depending on your current location and preference. The role also includes a flexible hybrid arrangement. The role involves occasional international travel, particularly to the UK and Iceland, depending on client projects.The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4500 €/month based on your experience.**Does this sound like the next step in your career?**Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English latest by the 29th of November via aTalent's application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/397753/create/.Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received.
