title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilitiesYour profile- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)- Fluent in English and preferably GermanBenefits- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discountsYour next step - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

title: Information Security Officer (Junior)
description: JBT Marel is seeking an Information security officer (Junior).Purpose:The Information Security Officer is part of the Information Security department within JBT Marel. The Information Security department is responsible for both Risk Management and Security Operations. The Information Security Officer supports the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security framework across the business. The role acts as a security liaison between business, technology and security teams and provides practical, risk-aligned guidance within assigned areas of responsibility.It is your mission to help identify, assess and document security risks across information, processes, projects and technologies, and to support the mitigation of those risks. You know how to collaborate with stakeholders, communicate clearly, and balance security requirements with business value and usability. The Information Security Officer closely cooperates with Cyber Security Specialists and other Information Security colleagues in audits, change management, incident coordination, awareness activities, policy updates and continuous improvement initiatives. Reports to:Chief Information Security Officer. Key areas of accountability: Risk management and advisory:Identify, assess and document security risks across information processes, projects and technologies within assigned areas of responsibility.Provide constructive security advisory for inquiries related to areas of responsibility, applying established guidelines and escalating complex topics where needed.Collaborate with business stakeholders to provide clear guidance and support the development of pragmatic, risk-aligned solutions.Support mitigation planning by providing input on security risks, controls and improvement actions.Policy management:Write and update security policies, standards and procedures for assigned areas of responsibility.Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of JBT Marel’s security policies, standards and procedures.Identify gaps in policies, standards and guidelines and propose improvements to reduce security risks. Security awareness:Promote security awareness by delivering training and championing Information Security objectives.Assess current security awareness maturity in assigned areas and use insights to drive targeted improvements and clear communication.Support the adoption of the right security behavior based on JBT Marel’s policies, standards and guidelines. Reporting, audits and operations:Report on security posture and incidents within assigned areas of responsibility.Participate in technical and non-technical audits, change management processes and incident coordination activities.Apply established guidelines to analyze and resolve routine security issues.Identify opportunities for control enhancement and process improvement in assigned areas of responsibility.Support continuous improvement of the organization’s security posture and monitor advancements in Information Security best practices.Team contribution:Operate with moderate supervision and seek guidance where needed.Support onboarding or training of new team members when requested.Provide input to employee performance evaluations as needed.Competencies and Skills:     Relating and networkingPresenting and communicating informationWriting and reportingAnalytical thinkingCooperativePro-activeConceptual/forward thinkingThoroughnessStress managementPragmatic and risk-based mindsetProficient English writing and speakingLevel of Knowledge and Experience:Bachelor level in information management and auditing, IT/information security, computer sciences, or a suitable combination of formal education and experience.1 - 3 years of experience in information security, risk management, IT audit, technology governance or a related field.Basic understanding of risk management, security policy management, security awareness, incident coordination and control improvement.Knowledge of international security standards or frameworks, such as ISO 27001, IEC 62443, OWASP, CIS Controls, NIST or ISF Standard of Good Practice, is desired.Preferred: experience in working in an international/ global organization.Preferred: knowledge of the manufacturing industry and business model/processes.Why Join JBT Marel?Joining JBT Marel means becoming part of a global leader in food processing technology that is helping feed the world more sustainably. You'll collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple countries, work on strategic global initiatives, and have opportunities to develop your career in an innovative, purpose-driven organization committed to continuous improvement, customer success, and operational excellence. title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. title: Construction - Civil Engineer Intern
description: As a Civil Engineer Intern, you will support multidisciplinary teams delivering water and wastewater projects in office and site environments while building practical skills across project delivery, quality, safety and sustainability. This is a formal internship opportunity undertaken as part of relevant Civil Engineering degree course or related studies. Under the guidance of senior staff, you will develop practical and professional skills, gain insight into how projects are planned, priced and delivered, and complete or return to your studies with stronger industry experience. Graduate Programme Pathway Final-year students graduating in 2027 who successfully complete the internship will, if they wish to continue with Glanua, be entitled to an immediate offer for the Glanua Civil Engineering Graduate Programme starting in September 2027, with no further interviews required. The two-year Civil Engineering Graduate Programme combines live project experience with structured mentoring, training, one 12-month rotation and two six-month rotations. A six-month rotation may be available in Portugal or the UK, subject to business requirements and suitability, and graduates receive support towards future professional accreditation. Develop foundational setting-out skills under supervision and gain practical experience using laser levels and dumpy levels. Learn to interpret civil, reinforcement and construction drawings with guidance from senior engineers. Quality Safety and Sustainability Promote and follow Glanua's health, safety, environmental, quality and sustainability standards, policies and procedures. Support site inductions, statutory inspections, record keeping and the collection of project and safety data. Learn and practise basic concrete quality-control activities, including slump testing, cube sampling, curing and accurate recording of results. Assist with quality checks and maintain clear records of site activities and outcomes. Learning Collaboration and Development Build familiarity with BIM, Revit and drafting tools and develop an understanding of how digital information supports project delivery. Learn about water and wastewater treatment processes, including potential exposure to modular package treatment plant fabrication. Communicate clearly with colleagues and contribute positively to multidisciplinary project and site teams. Take part in mentoring, continuous learning and feedback.

In Relation to the Staff Team    Work collaboratively as part of the house team, supporting a positive and respectful team culture.    Follow guidance from the House/Team Leader and contribute to the smooth running of the house.    Participate in team meetings, training, and reflective practice.    Communicate effectively with colleagues regarding Core Members’ needs and daily updates.    Support new staff and volunteers through welcoming and sharing knowledge of daily routines.    Contribute to a supportive and cooperative team environment.    Attend support and supervision sessions In Relation to Volunteer Assistants    Welcome and include Volunteer Assistants as part of the team.    Support volunteers in understanding their role and the daily life of the house.    Work alongside volunteers to ensure consistent and supportive care for Core Members.    Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, and shared responsibility. In Relation to the House / Community    Actively participate in the daily life and routines of the house.    Support meal preparation, cleaning, and general household tasks.    Contribute to creating a warm, welcoming, and inclusive home environment.    Support celebrations, events, and community gatherings.    Encourage Core Members’ participation in the wider community.    Maintain awareness of health and safety procedures and follow all policies.

description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico ICP OES/ICP MS Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. Hai sempre desiderato lavorare in un settore dinamico e orientato al futuro, contribuendo così alla produzione di energia sostenibile e rinnovabile? Questa è la tua occasione per contribuire a plasmare un futuro verde insieme a Thöni Sustainable Solutions! Da oltre 30 anni realizziamo impianti di biogas in tutto il mondo e siamo leader tecnologici in questo settore. 1 Tecnico_a di messa in servizio Location:

Italia

Type of Employment:

Full time

Your tasks

* Esecuzione autonoma della messa in servizio di impianti di biogas e dei relativi componenti

* Controlli funzionali e di sicurezza di tutti i sistemi in conformità alle norme tecniche

* Regolazione e ottimizzazione dei parametri dell'impianto per un funzionamento conforme al contratto

* Assistenza durante il collaudo tecnico

* Formazione e istruzione del personale operativo in loco

* Documentazione dei lavori eseguiti e verbali di consegna

* Stretta collaborazione con i responsabili di progetto, i tecnici e il team di assistenza

Your profile

* Formazione tecnica completata (ad es. meccatronico, elettrotecnico) o qualifica equivalente

* Esperienza nel settore degli impianti a biogas, degli impianti energetici o delle messe in servizio industriali - almeno 3 anni

* Conoscenze di tecnologia di controllo, regolazione e misurazione

* Disponibilità a viaggiare regolarmente all'estero

* Stile di lavoro autonomo, strutturato e orientato alle soluzioni

* Capacità di lavorare in team, impegno e orientamento al cliente

* Italiano come lingua madre o fluente, buona padronanza del tedesco o dell'inglese

Our offer

In qualità di datore di lavoro attraente, offriamo a persone di talento e motivate incarichi stimolanti e variegati in un contesto internazionale, con opportunità di crescita a lungo termine. In quanto azienda familiare di successo, attribuiamo grande importanza a un clima di rispetto reciproco e a una collaborazione orientata al lavoro di squadra. Inoltre, ci impegniamo attivamente a favore della sostenibilità e della tutela dell'ambiente, implementando processi che preservano le risorse e lavorando costantemente alla riduzione della nostra impronta ecologica.

Obermarktstraße 48, A-6410 Telfs

title: dirigente delle risorse umane
description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. Retribuzione: 90.000€ -120.000€ in base all'esperienza del profillo Auto aziendale Location: Ufficio collocato nella provincia di Varese Sud-est #LI-AM Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. Il posizionamento all'interno della fascia sarà determinato sulla base delle competenze e dell'esperienza professionale coerenti con i requisiti della posizione. *Grafton Office è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). description: Gi Pro Mechanics 4.0 is Gi Group's specialist division—Italy's leading multinational employment company—focused on enhancing candidates' experience, skills and potential in the mechanical, mechatronic and electromechanical fields. For Ferrero Ardennes, a global leader in the confectionery industry, we are recruiting: ELECTRONICS MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS / MAINTENANCE SUPERVISORS FOR FERRERO - BELGIUM At Ferrero's ARLON site you will find: Highly automated production lines and latest-generation Industry 4.0 technologies A solid, structured and merit-based organization that values strategic maintenance skills An international environment with many colleagues who have relocated from Italy and from all over the world The selected candidate will join the maintenance team (about 90 people) and will be responsible for routine, extraordinary, preventive/predictive and breakdown maintenance on automated systems within the Arlon production site. Offer Gross annual salary between €45,000 and €60,000 Company-provided accommodation for the first two months Relocation allowance of €8,000 gross Electronic meal vouchers with a nominal value of €10 per working day 13.92 monthly payments Belgian Collective Labour Agreement CCT118 Job grade: skilled maintenance worker Supplementary health insurance (DKV) for the employee, spouse/partner and dependent children up to 25 years old Electronic gift voucher worth €40 net The client company will also cover the costs of a French language course. title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. Richiesta presenza in plant, con con possibilità di smart working fino a 8 giorni al mese. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato; CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico; Livello di inquadramento: B2. La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui (RAL), definita in base all'inquadramento, alle mansioni e alle caratteristiche del profilo. Sono inoltre previsti mensa aziendale, piano welfare, pacchetto benefit dedicato alla cura della persona e formazione tecnica continua sulle tecnologie avanzate utilizzate all'interno del reparto Engineering. Sede di lavoro: San Giovanni Teatino (CH), con contributo mensile alla relocation per candidati/e provenienti da fuori regione. title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Hybrid working model: Smart Working options and flexible hours to help you achieve a better work-life balance. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. title: agente d’affari in mediazione
description: Sei un talento nelle vendite e cerchi un'opportunità per esprimere il tuo potenziale? Ti piace costruire relazioni con i clienti e collaborazioni solide? Potremmo avere l'opportunità giusta per te! Grafton Sales&Marketing è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati nei ruoli di vendita e marketing. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per azienda leader nel mondo della distribuzione moderna organizzata con focus nel canale Ho.Re.Ca. selezioniamo: DIGITAL SALES - Ho.Re.Ca. Per realtà che vanta oltre 50 anni di esperienza al fianco di tutti i professionisti della ristorazione e dell'ospitalità, offre la possibilità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e stimolante, caratterizzato da un continuo ascolto dei trend di mercato e dalla volontà di cogliere sempre nuove sfide commerciali, volte alla crescita economica e ad un sempre maggiore presidio del mercato. Specialista nel food service Horeca pone ogni giorno 'il cliente al centro' attraverso l'elevata consulenza professionale del proprio Team commerciale ed un servizio logistico puntuale e costante. Di cosa ti occuperai? Farai parte di un'azienda determinata a valorizzare al meglio i propri venditori, quali elementi chiave tra azienda e cliente e portavoce della Mission aziendale. con l'obiettivo principale di vendere in maniera proattiva soluzioni e servizi digitali ai clienti per fidelizzarli ulteriormente: - Scouting dei potenziali clienti interessati all'attivazione e al testing di servizi/tool digitali; - Vendita proattiva e diretta di tool/servizi digitali (es: Costruzione siti web, tool di prenotazione tavoli e ordini online + sistema gestionale di cassa POS + sistema di pagamento DISH PAY) ai clienti già fidelizzati; - Conversione dei leads e altri canali; - Assistenza post-vendita sui tool/servizi ai clienti, per supportare il cliente nel generare valore aggiunto al proprio business; - Monitora e raccoglie feedback dai clienti e dal mercato in ottica di miglioramento della strategia di vendita e del prodotto. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? - Pregressa esperienza di almeno 2 anni in contesti di consulenza e vendita B2B di servizi/soluzioni digitali nel canale Horeca; - In possesso di Patente B; - Diploma di Scuola Media Superiore; - Ottime doti comunicative e relazionali, passione per la vendita, capacità di pianificazione e organizzazione. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo determinato diretto con l'azienda CCNL applicato: Distribuzione moderna organizzata Livello di inquadramento: III livello Retribuzione prevista: La retribuzione annua lorda è compresa tra 27000€ e 31000€. È inoltre prevista diaria giornaliera del valore di 16€, previsto un sistema incentivante secondo i criteri definiti dalla contrattazione aziendale, auto uso promiscuo, PC, Cellulare, carta carburante. Luogo di lavoro: Pisa, LaSpezia Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! *Grafton Sales&Marketing è una specializzazione di Gi Group Spa autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut.
