title: HR People Officer - LöFAB
description: Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.HR People Officer till LöFABVill du vara med och bygga framtidens arbetsplats i ett framgångsrikt industriföretag där människor, kompetens och utveckling är avgörande framgångsfaktorer? Hos LöFAB får du en central och affärsnära HR-roll med ett brett ansvar för företagets kompetensförsörjning, arbetsmiljöarbete och medarbetarutveckling. Här får du möjlighet att påverka verksamheten på riktigt genom att säkerställa att organisationen har rätt kompetens, rätt processer och rätt förutsättningar för att fortsätta växa.LöFAB är ett modernt tillverkande företag som ställer höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet, struktur och ständiga förbättringar. Som HR People Officer blir du en viktig del av verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling och ansvarar för att HR-arbetet bedrivs i linje med företagets mål, lagkrav och interna styrande dokument. Rollen kombinerar strategiskt HR-arbete med operativa arbetsuppgifter och innebär många kontaktytor både internt och externt.Ditt uppdrag omfattar hela kedjan inom kompetensförsörjning och talangattraktion. Du arbetar aktivt med employer branding och representerar LöFAB i externa forum för att stärka företagets attraktionskraft som arbetsgivare. Du driver och utvecklar arbetet med rekrytering och säkerställer att verksamheten har tillgång till den kompetens som krävs både idag och i framtiden.En viktig del av rollen är att utveckla, utbilda och säkerställa effektiva processer för preboarding, onboarding och offboarding. Du ansvarar för att nya medarbetare får en bra start i organisationen och att rutiner, processer och arbetssätt håller hög kvalitet genom hela medarbetarresan. Du arbetar också med att dokumentera, utveckla och följa upp företagets kompetensmatriser och kompetensutvecklingsplaner samt planerar och genomför utbildningsinsatser utifrån verksamhetens behov.Du arbetar nära organisationens chefer och är en viktig partner i frågor som rör arbetsmiljö, personalutveckling och organisatorisk utveckling. Tillsammans med chefer och skyddsorganisation ansvarar du för företagets systematiska arbetsmiljöarbete och bidrar till att skapa en säker, hållbar och attraktiv arbetsplats. Du följer upp sjukfrånvaro, analyserar statistik, driver förbättringsinitiativ och hanterar rehabiliteringsärenden när behov uppstår.I rollen ansvarar du även för HR-administration och hantering av medarbetarrelaterade personuppgifter enligt GDPR. Du säkerställer att lagkrav, regulatoriska krav, kundkrav och interna riktlinjer efterlevs inom ditt område samt bidrar till att företagets mål inom kvalitet, arbetsmiljö, informationssäkerhet, leveransprecision och verksamhetsutveckling uppnås.Som HR People Officer förväntas du arbeta strukturerat och proaktivt med ständiga förbättringar. Du identifierar risker, avvikelser och utvecklingsmöjligheter samt säkerställer att dessa hanteras utan onödiga dröjsmål. Du bidrar till en kultur där rätt kompetens, tydliga processer och ett aktivt förbättringsarbete skapar förutsättningar för både medarbetarnas och företagets framgång.Vi söker dig som har en relevant högskoleutbildning inom HR eller motsvarande kompetens som förvärvats genom erfarenhet. Du har god förståelse för arbetsrätt, HR-processer, arbetsmiljöarbete och kompetensutveckling. Vi tror också att du har erfarenhet från tillverkande industri eller annan verksamhet med höga krav på struktur, kvalitet och efterlevnad. Du är van att arbeta digitalt, dokumentera ditt arbete och använda affärssystem och stödsystem i det dagliga arbetet.Som person är du självgående, förtroendeingivande och kommunikativ. Du har förmågan att skapa starka relationer på alla nivåer i organisationen och trivs i en roll där du kombinerar operativt genomförande med långsiktig utveckling. Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och har ett genuint intresse för människor, organisation och ledarskap.Hos LöFAB erbjuds du en utvecklande och ansvarsfull roll där du får vara med och påverka företagets framtida kompetensförsörjning, kultur och arbetsmiljö. Du blir en nyckelperson i organisationen och får möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad för både verksamheten och människorna som arbetar där.I denna rekrytering samarbetar LöFAB med FSK Group. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Klicka här för att söka tjänsten: https://www.fskgroup.se/lediga-jobb?uuid=474acad5-0173-4063-866f-36de4eeca237&type=position

title: Finance Associate - LÖVSTJÄRNAN FABRIKS AB
description: Lövstjärnan Fabriks AB (LöFAB) is a Swedish defence manufacturing company established to support Nordic and NATO security-of-supply requirements through manufacturing, co-production, and lifecycle sustainment through partnerships and sub-contracts with global OEMs. LöFAB provides an EU-based industrial solution that enables compliant production, long-term support, and scalable capacity within Europe.Finance Associate till LöFABVill du bygga en karriär inom ekonomi i ett växande industriföretag där du får arbeta nära verksamheten och samtidigt utvecklas inom både redovisning, analys och finansiell styrning? Hos LöFAB får du en bred och utvecklande roll där du blir en viktig del av ekonomifunktionen och bidrar till att skapa underlag för välgrundade affärsbeslut och företagets fortsatta tillväxt.LöFAB är en framgångsrik industriverksamhet där kvalitet, struktur och ständiga förbättringar genomsyrar det dagliga arbetet. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en organisation som värdesätter ansvarstagande, samarbete och utveckling. Som Finance Associate blir du en central del av Finance & Administration-teamet och arbetar nära CFO samt övriga delar av verksamheten.I rollen ansvarar du för flera av företagets grundläggande ekonomiprocesser och får en bred förståelse för hur ekonomifunktionen bidrar till verksamhetens framgång. Du arbetar med kundreskontra där fakturering, betalningsuppföljning och avstämningar ingår i det dagliga arbetet. Du hanterar även leverantörsreskontran med registrering av fakturor, betalningar och löpande avstämningar för att säkerställa korrekta och effektiva processer.Du medverkar aktivt i månads- och årsbokslut och arbetar med kontoavstämningar samt kvalitetssäkring av ekonomisk information. Rollen innebär också att du stöttar verksamheten i budgetarbete, prognoser och löpande uppföljning av ekonomiska resultat. Genom att ta fram månadsrapporter, nyckeltal och ekonomiska analyser bidrar du med viktiga beslutsunderlag för ledning och verksamhet.Som Finance Associate fungerar du även som ett finansiellt stöd till organisationen genom analyser, utredningar och olika ad hoc-uppgifter. Du deltar i interna kontroller, revisioner och förbättringsinitiativ inom ekonomifunktionen och är med och driver utvecklingen av processer, rutiner och ekonomisystem för att skapa ännu effektivare arbetssätt.Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll där struktur, noggrannhet och analysförmåga är avgörande för framgång. Du har en akademisk utbildning inom ekonomi, redovisning, företagsekonomi eller annat relevant område och har grundläggande kunskaper inom redovisning och ekonomiska processer. Du arbetar obehindrat i Excel och har erfarenhet av ekonomisystem. Eftersom rollen har många kontaktytor både internt och externt behöver du behärska engelska väl i både tal och skrift.Som person är du analytisk, strukturerad och noggrann. Du har lätt för att planera och prioritera ditt arbete samtidigt som du kan anpassa dig till förändrade förutsättningar och ett högt arbetstempo. Du är initiativtagande, nyfiken och vill ständigt utveckla dina kunskaper inom ekonomi. Vi tror också att du är en lagspelare med god kommunikativ förmåga som trivs med att samarbeta med olika funktioner i verksamheten.Hos LöFAB får du en utvecklande roll där du får arbeta brett inom ekonomi och bygga en stabil plattform för din fortsatta karriär. Du blir en del av ett företag med höga ambitioner, korta beslutsvägar och goda möjligheter att påverka både ditt arbete och verksamhetens utveckling.I denna rekrytering samarbetar LöFAB med FSK Group. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vi ser gärna att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.Klicka här för att söka tjänsten: https://www.fskgroup.se/lediga-jobb?uuid=97eb733a-4721-4917-ad6c-6e51e86cd093&type=position

title: Sälj och Marknadsföringsassistent
description: SALES/BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND MARKETING ASSOCIATEAt Enable Banking, we build the Open Banking infrastructure behind the financial products. Our mission is simple; to turn Open Banking into a relevant foundtition of companies. We're now looking for a Sales & Marketing Associate to help us on that mission. This is a hybrid role with a 50/50 split: half of your time goes to sales and business development, and half goes to marketing, content, and brand.  A key part of this role is helping us grow beyond the EU. As we expand into new non-EU markets (such as the UK, Moldova, Serbia, Georgia, Albania, and other countries with developing Open Banking ecosystems), you'll help research these markets, build our first customer and partner relationships there, and adapt our positioning to each local context.Role DescriptionAs a Sales & Marketing Associate at Enable Banking, you won't just book meetings or publish posts. You'll own the link between the two: turning market insight into stories and campaigns, and turning those campaigns into qualified conversations and pipeline. Because we're a small company, your impact will be immediate and visible. The content you create and the conversations you start will directly influence our pipeline, our positioning, and how we talk about our product. You'll work closely with sales, marketing, product, and leadership, helping bring financial products to market across industries such as accounting software, lending, and next-generation fintech. If you enjoy both the analytical and the creative side of growth, are motivated by results, and are curious about how digital financial infrastructure can create real-world impact, we'd love to hear from you.Who we areEnable Banking operates at the forefront of Open Banking. We’re an Open Banking provider operating across 29 EU countries, helping companies access high-quality financial data through one scalable API. Join us in a dynamic environment and help us to help our customers to commercialize our technology.Enable Banking is an AISP operating as a PSD2 API aggregator, integrating to all the major banks across the EU. Our customers integrate to Enable Banking’s API and gain access to all the major banks, instead of integrating to each bank individually. We're looking for a person who thrives on jumping into the action, tackling new challenges head on, and learning fast alongside our growing, ambitious team. Here, challenges aren’t obstacles, they’re opportunities to learn, grow, and make a real impact every day.Your daily mission includes: Sales & Business Development (50%)- Respond to and qualify all inbound leads, ensuring no opportunity slips through the cracks 📞- Research target markets, segments, and use cases to build highly targeted prospect lists 🔍- Support our expansion into non-EU markets (UK, Serbia, Georgia, Moldova, and similar), from market sizing and regulatory landscape mapping to first outreach and partner building - Build and nurture relationships with prospective customers and partners, and book meetings that drive growth  - Keep HubSpot updated and actively follow up on prospects throughout the pipeline 💻Marketing & Content (50%)- Write and publish content for LinkedIn and other digital channels, including company posts, thought leadership, and customer stories ✍️- Plan and support marketing campaigns and events, and represent Enable Banking at industry events and conferences across the EU - Translate Open Banking use cases and market trends into clear, engaging messaging for different industries and new markets 💡- Build go-to-market materials and campaigns for new non-EU markets, adapted to local audiences, regulation, and use cases- Track performance across web, social, and campaigns through dashboards and analytics, and use the insights to optimise content and conversion 📈- Work closely with sales, product, and leadership to keep messaging, positioning, and sales materials aligned 🤝What we’re looking for:- Bachelor's and Master's degrees from top-tier universities or business schools (such as Handelshögskolan/KTH) in a relevant field, such as in Economics, Business or Finance 🎓- Experience in B2B sales, business development, or marketing, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or financial services in multinational companies.- A solid understanding of Open Banking and related concepts such as APIs, PSD2, PSD3, FiDA, and Open Finance 🧠- Excellent written and spoken English. English is our working language, and you'll write for external audiences daily- Strong marketing and writing skills, with experience creating content for social media, newsletters, or publications- Analytical mindset: comfortable with market research, data, and dashboards to spot trends, opportunities, and use cases- Understanding of, or strong interest in, financial markets and Open Banking developments outside the EU.- A proactive, self-starting mindset. You take initiative and make things happen- Team player attitude with a focus on win-win outcomes Bonus if you have:- Experience with digitalization or digital transformation projects across the public and private sectors- Experience working with international organisations, clients, or multicultural teams 🌍- Market research or market-entry experience in the UK, the South Caucasus, or Eastern Europe- Experience with HubSpot or similar CRM and marketing automation tools- Event planning, outreach, or public speaking experience- Experience in graphic design- Proficiency in languages relevant to our new markets, such as Russian or Georgian, is a plusEmployment TypeFull-time - Hybrid - Stockholm, Sweden

title: Head of Security Operations
description: Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters. Your roleDo you want to develop security at one of Sweden's most high-tech companies? Security is prioritized, on top management's agenda and crucial for competitiveness, profitability and trust on a challenging global market. Saab Naval Security Department is looking for a Head of Security Operations. As Head of Security Operations, you are a manager with personnel responsibility, and report directly to Head of Security at the business area (BA) Naval. You will work in an international environment where advanced security threats are part of everyday business alongside complex business environments and projects with high business impact. In the role as Head of Security Operations, you are highly operational but should also feel a tactical responsibility to build and strengthen a general security culture within the BA. You will develop security practices to meet both external and internal security protection requirements. You will work closely with the entire Security Department, but in particular with Business Unit (BU) Security, Supply Chain Security and Security Office at Saab Naval. Your main tasks will be:    Coordinating security through all the BU Security and be the contact person for all security issues    Leading security protection planning according to all the BU contracts that require security protection    Leading and ensuring regulatory compliance, such as continuously reviewing and evaluating applicable laws, regulations, requirements and agreements for the BU related to security protection    Being the bridge between the Security Officers in your organization and Head of Security in security-related matters You will liaise and collaborate extensively internally and externally. Business Area Naval provides the most efficient platforms on and under the sea, both for the military and civilian domain. The portfolio covers submarines, surface ships, combat boats, under- surface vessels, torpedoes and more. Within Saab Security, we have anchored a Saab wide ambition to become world leading in security risk management and to be referred to by other security professionals as the company having the best practices in place. Your profile Required skills:    Documented experience from leading teams, personnel responsibility    Documented experience in Swedish Security Protection Act    Good communication skills in Swedish and English, verbal and written    Several years of experience from working with security related legislation and legal frameworks Desired skills:    Several years of experience of working for government authorities or in a global company, including an understanding of security related issues in the business process    Leadership/management experience    Experience from and an ability to build and maintain networks and good relations inside as well as outside your own organization You are a true team player, and as such you focus on team results.Personal qualities will be of the outmost importance, and it is paramount that you are trustworthy with strong ethics and personal integrity. You understand the need for balanced security in a business-driven environment. As an Information Security Officer at Saab Kockums, you are likely to get in contact with classified information. This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply. What you will be a part ofExplore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters. Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world. Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here. Kindly observe that this is an ongoing recruitment process and that the position might be filled before the closing date of the advertisement.

title: Senior Plasma Experimentalist
description: About the JobIntertalents Consulting AB is recruiting a Senior Plasma Experimentalist on behalf of a client working with advanced experimental physics and energy technology.We are looking for an experienced physicist who can combine practical laboratory expertise with a strong understanding of plasma behaviour and experimental data. The position offers an opportunity to influence how our client plans experiments, evaluates results, and develops its scientific capabilities.About the Role:In this role, you will join our client’s multidisciplinary research and development team. Your work will connect experimental design, plasma diagnostics, and data analysis, helping the team turn scientific questions into practical experiments and meaningful conclusions.You will provide senior scientific input throughout experimental campaigns and work closely with specialists in physics, instrumentation, data analysis, theory, and simulation. You will also contribute to technical decisions, support less experienced colleagues, and bring the experimental perspective into discussions about future research priorities.Your Key Responsibilities:    Translate scientific objectives into experimental approaches and measurement plans.    Provide technical guidance during the preparation, execution, and evaluation of experimental campaigns.    Develop and apply analysis methods that help explain observed plasma behaviour.    Assess experimental results using relevant physical models, detector principles, and simulation tools.    Recommend improvements to diagnostic capabilities, measurement methods, and experimental procedures.    Take ownership of scientific and technical challenges, working independently and together with other specialists.    Support junior colleagues through practical guidance and knowledge sharing.    Contribute to discussions about the direction and priorities of our client’s experimental research.Who You Are:We are looking for a senior physicist who enjoys working close to experiments and investigating complex scientific problems. You combine analytical depth with a practical approach and can move between detailed technical work and broader research questions.You are proactive, collaborative, and willing to support colleagues across different disciplines. You are comfortable making independent technical assessments and adapting your approach as new experimental findings emerge.We believe you have:    Several years of relevant experience in experimental physics, with the ability to independently address complex experimental challenges.    A strong practical background in designing experiments and developing, implementing, and applying physics data analysis methods.    Experience interpreting experimental observations through an understanding of the underlying physics, detector behaviour, and relevant simulations.    Hands-on experience with linear plasma devices.    The ability to take technical responsibility and contribute scientific expertise within a multidisciplinary team.It is considered a plus if you also have:    A PhD in plasma physics, experimental physics, or a related discipline, supported by scientific publications.    Experience developing software for plasma research or scientific data analysis.    Experience working in collaborative laboratory settings where priorities and experimental needs evolve.    Experience supporting the development of junior researchers or engineers.Your expertise may cover one or more of the following areas:    Plasma instabilities, transport, heating, and fueling.    Operation and diagnostics of linear plasma systems, including mirror and cusp configurations.    Optical and particle diagnostics, such as spectroscopy, interferometry, tomography, imaging, probes, and particle detection.    Diagnostic calibration and the effects of plasma exposure on measurement equipment.    Plasma-surface interactions, including wall conditioning, erosion, and deposition.    Analysis of time-dependent signals using spectral, filtering, correlation, and statistical methods.    Numerical modelling and simulation of plasma phenomena using relevant scientific software.Application Process:Intertalents Consulting AB is managing this recruitment on behalf of our client. We review applications and conduct interviews continuously, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position may be filled before the application deadline.The start date will be agreed upon with our client. A background check may form part of the recruitment process.What We Offer:Through this recruitment, we offer the opportunity to join a technically advanced environment at our client, where experimental research contributes to the development of future energy solutions.You will collaborate with specialists from different scientific and engineering disciplines and have the opportunity to influence experimental methods, share your expertise, and contribute to the team’s continued development.The position is permanent and full-time, based in Stockholm. Some flexibility for remote work is available, although most of the work takes place at our client’s office and laboratory facilities. We welcome applications from candidates in Sweden and abroad. Relocation support may be available where needed.Diversity & Inclusion:At Intertalents, we welcome applications regardless of gender, nationality, background, or ethnicity. We value a broad range of experiences and perspectives and work to support an inclusive recruitment process.

title: Frontend Engineer-20856
description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an experienced and technically driven Frontend Engineer for a consulting assignment within a fast-growing, international product company. The assignment focuses on developing and scaling a modern digital platform, with particular emphasis on frontend architecture, performance, accessibility, and technical excellence.The role is suited to an engineer with strong hands-on expertise in React and TypeScript, experience building complex web applications, and the ability to take ownership of critical parts of a product's frontend architecture.A central part of the mission is to build high-quality, scalable, and responsive user interfaces while ensuring excellent performance, maintainability, and accessibility. The engineer will work closely with product, design, and backend teams in a fast-paced, product-oriented environment.Key Responsibilities    Lead the design, development, and deployment of features across the client's web platform.    Design, develop, and maintain scalable frontend architecture using React and TypeScript.    Take ownership of key areas of the codebase, ensuring high standards of code quality, maintainability, and scalability.    Build modern, intuitive, and responsive user interfaces with a strong focus on user experience.    Collaborate closely with product and design teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions.    Contribute to the development and maintenance of design systems, frontend architecture, and integrations.    Optimize application performance and ensure excellent Core Web Vitals across complex user interfaces.    Ensure web accessibility in accordance with WCAG standards, including keyboard navigation and screen reader support.    Work with backend developers and contribute across the technology stack when required.Technical Stack & Requirements    Frontend: Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.    Backend: Experience with Node.js and the ability to contribute to backend development when required.    Frontend architecture: Strong understanding of application architecture, state management, data flows, and scalable frontend solutions.    Performance optimization: Practical experience optimizing frontend performance and working with Core Web Vitals, including LCP, INP, and CLS.    Web accessibility: Good knowledge of WCAG, keyboard navigation, and screen reader compatibility.    Complex applications: Experience building and optimizing large-scale, data-intensive, or complex user interfaces.    Cloud & deployment: Understanding of cloud environments, web application deployment, and production operations.    Engineering quality: Experience writing secure, maintainable, and scalable code and contributing to technical architecture decisions.Qualifications & ExperienceThe consultant will have a strong background in frontend engineering and proven experience developing and delivering modern web products. Deep practical expertise in React and TypeScript is essential, together with a solid understanding of frontend architecture, performance optimization, and accessibility.Experience working in product-driven technology companies, international engineering environments, or organizations with large-scale and complex digital platforms is highly advantageous.

The consultant will work within a decentralized security governance model, collaborating closely with engineering teams while contributing to common security standards, guidelines, and practices.This is a practical security engineering role combining operational security support, cloud security, DevSecOps enablement, and technical advisory responsibilities.Key Responsibilities    Provide hands-on title: HL7 Integration Engineer
description: RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia &amp; New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.RaySearch Laboratories is looking for an HL7 Integration Engineer to join our Service department. In this role, you will work with healthcare customers to integrate RayCare with hospital information systems and other third-party systems.You will be the main point of contact between the customer and RaySearch for HL7 integration projects, combining technical integration work with customer communication and project coordination.We are flexible regarding the location of this position, as long as you are based in Europe. Priority will be given to candidates based in Sweden, France, Spain, the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany. About the jobAs an HL7 Integration Engineer, you will support customers throughout the integration process, from understanding their technical environment and requirements to specifying, testing, and validating interfaces.The role involves close collaboration with customers as well as technical teams within RaySearch. You will work hands-on with HL7 messaging, troubleshoot integration issues, document solutions, and contribute to the planning and delivery of integration projects.An important part of the role is understanding what the customer needs, identifying what is technically feasible, and translating this into clear specifications, deliverables, and estimates.You will    Collaborate with customers and our technical teams to provide integration support for RayCare.    Develop integration specifications and workflows for HL7 messaging.    Test and validate HL7 interfaces with different hospital information systems.    Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues involving third-party systems.    Participate in project planning, implementation, and documentation.    Gather technical requirements from customers and translate them into clear integration specifications.    Contribute to estimates, quotations, and statements of work for integration projects.    Stay up to date with relevant standards and technologies within healthcare IT and HL7.    Share your knowledge and experience within the Service team.Your profileWe are looking for someone with practical experience of healthcare system integrations who is comfortable working directly with customers.To succeed in the role, we believe you have:    Practical experience working with HL7 v2 messaging.    Knowledge of FHIR and healthcare messaging and data exchange.    Basic programming or scripting skills, preferably in JavaScript or a similar language.    At least one year of relevant experience with healthcare integrations, either within a hospital IT/integration department or at a medical technology or healthcare software company. Relevant experience may also come from a clinical environment where you have worked with system integrations.    Professional proficiency in English.    The ability to communicate technical information clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.It is meritorious if you have:    Further experience with FHIR and an understanding of its role in modern healthcare interoperability.    Experience with integration engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect).    Knowledge of good development practices, including documentation, version control, and working in a controlled development environment.    Experience from an oncology environment, for example radiotherapy or chemotherapy.    Previous experience in customer-facing technical support or consulting.    Experience gathering customer requirements and translating them into technical scope and deliverables.    Experience preparing estimates, quotations, or statements of work, including assessing technical feasibility and estimating the effort required for an integration.    A command of other languages than EnglishOur Culture Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care. Our Offer At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package. Application Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

title: Mechanical Design Owner - Separators
description: At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. And we need people like you to make it happen.We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.Job SummaryAs Mechanical Design Owner, you will be responsible for defining mechanical design specifications and driving the development of innovative, reliable, and fit-for-purpose solutions for Separators. You will serve as a key technical expert, providing guidance and support across multiple functions, including Sales, Issue Resolution, PLC, and PC&L, to ensure engineering excellence throughout the project lifecycle. In this role, you will lead the resolution of complex technical challenges, facilitate design reviews, and represent the mechanical design function in technical discussions with customers and suppliers. You will play a pivotal role in promoting best practices, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and ensuring the highest standards of quality, performance, and compliance in mechanical design. The position is based in Lund, Sweden.  To support the operational requirements of this role, priority will be given to candidates who are already based locally and have the legal right to work in the country.What you will do    Deliver mechanical design templates, specifications and drawings on complex and customized separation solutions     Take lead and provide expert support in mechanical design to other areas like Sales, Issue resolution, Product Lifecycle, and Product Creation.     Proactively lead and coordinate communication with the order team, ensuring clear visibility of project status, risks, priorities, and order changes.     Plan, structure, and execute projects by defining phases, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring completion on time, in full, and within budget.     Drive productivity and efficiency through the effective utilization of standardized processes, reusable solutions, and approved component libraries.     Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and contribute to the development and enhancement of engineering processes, templates, tools, and best practices.     Act as a mentor and technical coach, supporting the development of colleagues within the organization and sharing expertise across functions.     Foster collaboration among cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.     Promote a culture of quality, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence in all project activities. We believe you have    Master's degree (MSc) in Mechanical Engineering, Product Development, or a related engineering discipline.     10-15 years of experience in a similar Mechanical Design Engineering or Lead Design Engineering role within an industrial or manufacturing environment.     Strong technical expertise with a proven understanding of equipment installation requirements and customer operations in on-site environments.     Extensive experience in the design and development of manufacturing and processing equipment, with a solid understanding of design-for-manufacturing principles.     Expert knowledge of mechanical design methodologies, including the development and implementation of engineering standards, guidelines, tools, and best practices.     Excellent understanding of product portfolios, system functionality, and the interaction between mechanical components and overall equipment performance.     Experience of working with safety solutions (CE marking/Machinery Regulation) for industrial equipment.     Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical discussions, drive engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, customers, and suppliers.     Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage technical challenges throughout the product lifecycle and deliver robust, customer-focused solutions.     Experience in mentoring and coaching engineers, promoting technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. We Offer You    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements Apply NowIf you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what's good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/. title: Development Engineer within R&D to Olink
description: Would you like to work hands-on with laboratory development and contribute to the next generation of Life Science products? At Olink, you will have the opportunity to be part of developing innovative protein biomarker panels that help researchers worldwide better understand complex diseases and advance the field of precision medicine. As a Development Engineer, you will combine practical laboratory work with method development, experimental evaluation, and the optimization of advanced workflows. We are looking for someone with experience in laboratory work within areas such as molecular biology, biotechnology, or assay development, who enjoys working hands-on in a laboratory environment and is motivated by turning scientific concepts into products that can make a real difference to human health. We look forward to receiving your application!About the roleOlink – Part of Thermo Fisher Scientific has experienced tremendous growth in recent years and has quickly made a global impact. Its groundbreaking products are used by leading research institutes and pharmaceutical companies to drive the next major breakthroughs in medicine. With headquarters and service laboratories in both Uppsala and Boston, Olink is a truly global Life Science company. Its technology is developed and used to provide new insights into complex diseases such as cancer, cardiovascular diseases, and neurological disorders – research that has the potential to genuinely change people's lives.Olink is now looking for a Development Engineer to join its R&D team, Reveal Development, which is responsible for developing a specific product line within mid-plex solutions. The team focuses on developing and evaluating new protein panels, assessing their performance, and optimizing the laboratory processes used in product development. In this role, you will contribute to hands-on development activities, conducting experiments and laboratory testing to help ensure that new panels and methods meet established requirements.The role is primarily hands-on and laboratory-based. Your responsibilities will include conducting experiments, performing pipetting, operating laboratory instruments, and working with automated processes. The team has a relatively new structure and is still evolving, but already offers a positive working environment where colleagues support one another and share knowledge. You will work closely with your team members while also collaborating with other functions across the organization. Your onboarding will include practical training, a structured onboarding checklist, and a dedicated mentor to support you during your initial period.This is a consultant assignment, meaning you will be employed by Academic Work and work on-site at Olink. The assignment will initially run for six months, with the possibility of an extension. The planned start date is February or March 2027. The role is primarily based on-site in the laboratory in Uppsala, with some flexibility to work remotely when the tasks allow.You are offered    The opportunity to work with innovative proteomics technology at an international Life Science company    A hands-on and rewarding role where you will contribute to the development of next-generation protein biomarker panels    The opportunity to combine laboratory work with method development, optimization, and automated processes    An important role within an R&D team, where your work directly contributes to the development of new products    A collaborative team of Development Engineers and Scientists, where knowledge sharing and mutual support are part of everyday work    A structured onboarding process, including a dedicated mentor and practical training    A workplace that our current consultants describe as fantasticWork tasksIn this role, you will primarily work hands-on in the laboratory with the experimental development and evaluation of new protein biomarker panels. You will collaborate closely with project leads and other team members to plan, conduct, and follow up on experiments. Your responsibilities will include:    Planning and conducting laboratory experiments in accordance with project plans and established timelines    Performing laboratory work, including pipetting and other molecular biology techniques    Evaluating the performance of assays and new protein biomarker panels using established analytical tools and quality criteria    Analyzing, documenting, and communicating experimental results in accordance with established procedures    Working with automated laboratory processes, including operating and setting up laboratory instruments    Contributing to the optimization and further development of laboratory methods and workflows    Collaborating with project leads on the planning, prioritization, and execution of project activities    Participating in technical discussions, troubleshooting activities, and scientific reviews    Collaborating cross-functionally with other R&D teams to support product development milestonesWe are looking for someone who    Holds a university degree in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or another relevant scientific discipline    Has experience in laboratory work within areas such as assay development, product development, or research-based laboratory environments    Has hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR, NGS library preparation, and/or immunoassays    Has experience analyzing and interpreting experimental data and drawing scientifically sound conclusions    Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to document and communicate results effectively    Has good knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPointIt is considered an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have    Experience with multiplex protein detection technologies or molecular diagnostics platforms    Experience working with laboratory automation systems and high-throughput workflows    Experience with LIMS and structured experimental doc

title: Finance Business Partner
description: Securitas Risk Intelligence (SRI)Securitas Risk Intelligence delivers actionable intelligence on the global security and threat landscape, creating decision-making advantage and confidence to protect people, property, and assets. As part of Securitas' intelligence-led approach to security, we combine data- and tech-driven insights with expert human analysis to deliver risk intelligence that is accurate, timely, relevant, and actionable.About the roleReporting to the CFO of Security Risk Management (SRM) and being part of SRI Leadership Team - the Finance Business Partner owns business controlling and performance management for SRI and acts as the finance business partner to VP SRI. The role will improve the speed and quality of decisions, strengthen adherence to the financial model, raise the quality of business cases and create systematic follow-up on expected benefits, supporting sustainable and profitable growth.Responsibilities    Business partnering and decision support: Act as the day-to-day finance partner to VP SRI and SRI leadership. Drive timelines, assumptions, quality and consistency with the agreed financial model. Ensure forecasts are robust, evidence-based and action-oriented.    Business cases and benefits tracking: Strengthen the quality and consistency of investment and commercial business cases. Test assumptions, quantify scenarios and risks, and establish disciplined post-decision follow-up against expected outcomes.    Reporting, data and automation: Improve data structures, definitions and controls. Use automation and AI where they materially improve speed, quality, scalability or insight.    Finance team collaboration: Work closely with the SRI Financial Controller, setting priorities for reporting, analysis and finance support. Leverage the Controller's ownership of financial control, data integrity and recurring processes to enable stronger performance management and business decision support.    Support to SRM: While the primary focus is on SRI, the role will provide targeted analytical and ad-hoc support to the CFO of SRM and contribute to broader SRM performance-management priorities and develop towards a wider remit over time.RequirementsCandidate profile    Analytical strength: analytical ability and data literacy. Able to structure ambiguous questions, reconcile conflicting information, identify root causes and form evidence-based conclusions.    Finance foundation: Grounding in business controlling, performance management, financial planning, modelling and business cases. Comfortable challenging senior stakeholders while remaining pragmatic.    Learning agility and potential: Learns unfamiliar businesses quickly, actively seeks responsibility, forms independent views and demonstrates clear capacity to grow into a broader role.    Technology mindset: Curiosity about data, systems, automation and AI. Executive polish is desirable but can be developed. Fluency in English.Indicative experience    Experience in business controlling, FP&A, performance management, transaction services, consulting, revenue operations or a comparable analytical finance role.    Demonstrated ownership of complex analysis, planning or business-case work, not only production of recurring reports.    Experience working with/presenting to senior business stakeholders.    Evidence of improving a process, analysis or decision workflow through better use of data, systems, automation or AI.    University degree in finance, economics, engineering, data or a comparable discipline.Personal characteristics    Curious and willing to investigate until the underlying logic is understood.    Independent in judgement and effective in a collaborative environment.    High ownership and pace, with the discipline to finish and follow through.    Comfortable moving between detailed analysis and broader commercial implications.    Ambitious to grow and motivated by building capability and improving the business.Working conditionsThe role is based in Stockholm and involves occasional travelling.Hybrid model applies (with 3 days in the office per week).If this sounds like the right next step in your career, don't hesitate and apply!

title: Risk & Compliance Officer

title: Quantity Surveyor/Change Management
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you'll doRight now, we are looking for a Quantity Surveyor/Change Management for one of our project areas. In this role, you will report to the Project Controls Manager and sit within the specific area. The team supports the project within its assigned area through cost, schedule and performance control.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following, but as we are a growing company with very little siloing between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Review and validate estimates, quantities and cost calculations for assigned packages.    Assess costs against design information, project scope and contractual requirements.    Review contractor change orders and variations, including quantities, cost build-ups and supporting justifications.    Challenge submissions where evidence or alignment with scope is unclear, and provide documented findings and recommendations.    Assess the cost impact of project changes and contribute to change control.    Coordinate with Project Controls, Contracts, Engineering and package teams to resolve information gaps and document cost assessments.    Support project reviews and follow up on agreed actions.Placement: Boden Employment type: Fixed-term employment (12–24 months)What you'll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking, and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below:    Experience in quantity surveying, estimating, cost assurance, or change and variation management on complex industrial or construction projects.    Experience reviewing large or complex packages and coordinating assessments across multidisciplinary teams.    Strong understanding of quantities, estimates, cost build-ups, design information and contractual scope.    Ability to identify gaps or risks, challenge cost submissions with evidence, and make clear recommendations.    Ability to maintain clear and traceable assessments and supporting documentation.    An analytical, detail-oriented and proactive approach, with the confidence to raise concerns constructively.Benefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden Site (Choose one)Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden VideoOur Stockholm Office (Choose one)Our modern Stockholm office is located on Norra Stationsgatan, close to Karolinska University Hospital in central Stockholm. Here, you’ll find a bright, collaborative workspace where cross-functional teams connect, share ideas, and drive progress. Whether you're visiting regularly or working hybrid, you'll be part of a vibrant office culture with easy access to the city’s energy and amenities.

title: Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner
description: We are looking for a Retail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner for a global company in Gothenburg (Mölndal). Start is December 16th, 5 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Mölndal).Assignment descriptionRetail Sales Academy & Learning Journey Design Partner﻿ Background:Our client has established a Retail Sales Job Architecture and Skills Building Framework across its Personal Care and Consumer Tissue business areas. The framework provides a common capability foundation across four Sales Profiles: Commercial Management, Account Management, Field Sales and Sales Enablement.﻿ The framework connects sales roles with functional and leadership skills, future capability requirements, onboarding, and ongoing development. The architecture, skills priorities, and strategic direction have already been defined. The objective of this assignment is not to redesign those foundations, but to translate them into a practical, scalable Retail Sales Academy with role- and skill-based learning journeys delivered through the company's Learning Experience Platform (LXP).﻿ The LXP brings learning resources together in one place and enables employees to discover relevant learning opportunities, career paths, and development experiences aligned to their needs, interests, and goals.﻿ The organization is seeking support to establish a practical and scalable Retail Sales Academy. The Academy will support approximately 1,500 employees across more than 20 markets. The focus is on implementing the existing framework and creating effective learning journeys rather than redefining capability models or long-term strategy.Estimated project duration: 4–6 months﻿ Overview and NeedEnglish will serve as the master language for the Academy. However, the solution must be designed for successful deployment across Europe, North America, and Latin America, ensuring that language does not become a barrier to understanding, adoption, or application.As a significant proportion of users are Spanish-speaking, it is important to accommodate local language requirements, particularly as many sales activities are conducted in local languages.A key principle is to use and adapt existing learning content wherever possible before creating new content. Learning journeys should provide meaningful progression and connect learning with practical application, manager coaching, and peer learning rather than simply aggregating courses.﻿ Responsibilities- Define the Academy structure, learner navigation, and curriculum, including governance, ownership, and maintenance.- Review existing learning content and map suitable assets to priority roles, skills, and proficiency levels.- Design coherent learning journeys with clear learning outcomes, logical sequencing, practical application activities, and reinforcement mechanisms.- Identify priority content gaps and selectively adapt or develop content where existing resources are insufficient.- Define a scalable language and localization strategy using English as the master language and local-language content where needed.- Prepare learning-path specifications, taxonomy structures, and metadata requirements for implementation in the Learning Experience Platform.- Deliver documentation, editable assets, and knowledge-transfer materials to support long-term ownership and maintenance by the organization.The consultant will work independently while collaborating closely with business stakeholders, SMEs, and learning teams.﻿ Required ExperienceThe ideal consultant has strong experience in corporate academy design, curriculum architecture, and role- or skill-based learning journeys, with the ability to translate business needs into scalable learning solutions.Relevant Experience- Designing corporate academies, curricula, and role-based learning journeys aligned with business capabilities and proficiency levels.- Assessing and curating large third-party learning libraries, selecting content based on relevance, quality, applicability, and business alignment.- Working with Cornerstone or comparable enterprise learning platforms and content ecosystems.- Applying a strong curate-before-create approach, maximizing existing content and minimizing unnecessary content development.- Developing learning solutions for sales and commercial functions.- Supporting learning initiatives across multiple countries and languages.- Establishing quality-assurance and maintenance processes for localized learning assets.- Integrating experiential learning, manager reinforcement, coaching, and practical application into learning journeys.- Collaborating effectively with subject-matter experts and business stakeholders.- Delivering implementation-ready outputs supported by structured documentation, handover, and knowledge transfer.﻿ Key Success FactorThe most important capability is the ability to translate existing frameworks and learning resources into practical, relevant, scalable, and maintainable learning journeys rather than creating large volumes of new content.This role requires fluency in English.This is a full-time consultant position in Gothenburg through Incluso. Start is December 16th, 5 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Gothenburg (Mölndal). Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.
