description: Vi söker framtidens nyckelpersoner som vill arbete med en av Dalarnas största näring - besöksnäringen!Brinner du för att utveckla människor, skapa fantastiska gästupplevelser och driva verksamheter framåt? Är du en engagerad ledare eller specialist som trivs i en miljö där service, kvalitet och affärsmässighet går hand i hand? Då vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig!På BOSS Business Partner samarbetar vi med många olika branscher och ser alltid framåt mot nästa spännande rekryterings- eller konsultuppdrag. Vi vill därför redan nu knyta kontakt med erfarna och drivna personer som är nyfikna på nya möjligheter.Vilka kompetenser söker vi?Vi är intresserade av att komma i kontakt med personer som har erfarenhet av ledarskap, drift, verksamhetsutveckling eller specialistkompetens inom besöksnäringen. Du kanske har jobbat i roller på skidanläggningar, hotell, restaurang, konferens och är nyfiken på nästa steg.Antingen finns du redan på plats i Dalarna eller så är du på väg att flytta hit permanent.Vem är du?Du kombinerar ett genuint intresse för människor och service med ett affärsmässigt tänkande. Du har förmågan att skapa engagemang, bygga och vara en del av välfungerande team samt bidrar till en verksamhet där både medarbetare och gäster stortrivs.Du är trygg i att möta olika typer av människor och trivs som bäst när det är mycket gäster och aktiviteter. När du har lovat något står du får det och ser till att det blir gjort och du är en person som ser möjligheter till utveckling och förbättring där andra kanske ser problem. Du trivs med att arbeta operativt och har förståelse för vikten av såväl den dagliga driften som långsiktiga mål.Kanske har du redan en specialistroll eller en ledande roll inom besöksnäringen och känner att det är dags för nästa utmaning? Eller så har du erfarenheter från en annan bransch som du vill ta med dig in i en ny miljö?Oavsett vilket är vi nyfikna på att höra mer om dig!Nya möjligheter börjar med ett samtalPå BOSS Business Partner tror vi på långsiktiga relationer och att rätt person på rätt plats gör verklig skillnad. Genom vårt breda nätverk och samarbeten som vi har med både stora och mindre företag får vi möjlighet att matcha kompetenta personer med spännande arbetsgivare och utvecklande roller.Vi vet också att ett karriärbyte inte alltid är något man aktivt söker efter. Ibland dyker rätt möjlighet upp när man minst anar det.Nyfiken på vad framtiden kan erbjuda?Välkommen att connecta med oss!Berätta gärna lite om din bakgrund, dina erfarenheter och vilken typ av roll eller utmaning du skulle vara intresserad av framöver.Det här är en intresseanmälan inför framtida rekryteringsuppdrag och inte en specifik ledig tjänst. När en möjlighet dyker upp som matchar din profil kan vi komma att kontakta dig.Vi ser fram emot att lära känna dig och kanske få vara en del av ditt nästa karriärsteg!BOSS Business Partner – vi hjälper människor och företag att utvecklas tillsammans.

title: Business Controller – R&D and Product
description: HMS stands for Hardware Meets Software and we work to make the world more connected, productive, and sustainable. Our industrial communication products enable millions of machines, such as robots, drives, and air-conditioning systems, to connect with software and information systems – a necessity for meeting future demands for energy efficiency and sustainability.What you’ll do Would you like to influence the financial success of innovative technology? As Business Controller, you’ll work at the intersection of finance, R&D and product development, helping turn ideas and investments into profitable products.You will be a financial business partner to R&D and Product Offering, supporting the teams in making informed financial and business decisions. You will provide insight into development costs, investments and product profitability, helping the business understand the financial impact of decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include:    Coordinate budgets and forecasts for R&D and Product Offering, analyzing spending and variances.    Follow development projects and investments, including business cases, and financial outcomes after product launch.    Analyze product profitability, standard costs and cost variances, identifying opportunities for cost improvements.    Maintain pricing data, support annual pricing process and implement approved price changes.    Develop reporting and use digital and AI tools to automate routine work and provide better business insight. Based in Halmstad, you will join INT Business Controlling and report to VP Business Controlling. You will be part of an experienced finance team, working closely with colleagues across the business. About you You are analytical, structured and curious about how the business works. You enjoy working closely with stakeholders and turning financial data into clear insights and decisions. We believe you have:     Experience in business controlling, financial analysis or a similar role.    A degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.    Strong Excel skills and good communication skills in English. Experience from a manufacturing environment, as well as familiarity with product or project controlling, cost accounting, Power BI or ERP systems, is an advantage. You do not need experience in every area of the role, we value curiosity, financial judgement and a collaborative approach. About us At HMS, we put Heart, Mind & Soul into everything we do. These core values not only make for a fitting abbreviation (HMS), but also describe how we work together and create success. We are an innovative growth company headquartered in Halmstad, Sweden, with approximately 1,100 employees in more than 20 countries. Through our global presence, we combine the opportunities of an international organisation with the close-knit and entrepreneurial spirit that has characterised HMS since the beginning. HMS is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels included, respected, and empowered. Visit hms-networks.com and learn more about life at HMS.

title: Business Controller - Hedin Import Operations
description: Do you want to be part of an interesting growth journey?Hedin Mobility Group is an exciting workplace consisting of a bunch of wonderful and talented people. If you appreciate a varied everyday life and prefer to work in a changing environment, you will thrive here. Our employees are the foundation of Hedin Mobility Group's successful growth for many years. There are many development opportunities in the Group and we want individuals with the right potential to have the opportunity to grow with us!Hedin Business Center is looking for a Business ControllerHedin Business Center provides professional and devoted support to our Import Operations including Hedin US Motor, the exclusive importer and distributor of the Ford F-150 in Europe - Hedin Adventure Car - the official distributor of INEOS Grenadier across 11 markets in Europe, Hedin Premium Car - the importer of the prestigious brand Hongqi in 6 markets in Europe and Hedin Distribution AG/SK/CZ - the official distributor of XPENG in Switzerland, Slovakia and Czech Republic. Who are we looking for?We are now looking for a Business Controller to further accelerate our operations across Europe. You will play a critical role in supporting the financial health and strategic decision-making of the various brands within our portfolio. Furthermore, you will be responsible for analyzing financial data, monitoring performance, and providing insights to improve profitability and cost efficiency. You will be welcomed by a positive team in a forward-thinking and fast-growing company. The position will be located in our attractive new office space in Mölndal and you will report to our CFO & Head of Business Center.You have a Masters degree in economics, accounting, engineering or equivalent and several (5+) years of work experience in controlling, financial analysis or similar roles. To thrive in the role as Business Controller, it is important that you are comfortable with ownership and responsibility. You are structured, analytical and always deliver timely and accurately. Furthermore, you are a team player who is also used to work independently. We believe you are an outgoing person who finds it both exciting and stimulating to meet new people, have fun at work and enjoy working in an ever-changing environment with high demands.Your key areas of responsibility:    Business Performance Monitoring: Track and analyze business performance by evaluating financial data and key business metrics, ensuring that targets are met.    Financial Planning and Analysis: Prepare and manage annual Budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial planning. Analyze Budget deviations and provide actionable insights to improve financial outcomes.    Reporting: Deliver regular financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow reports, and key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring accuracy and timeliness.    Cost Control: Monitor and evaluate operational expenses, identify areas for cost reduction, and recommend measures to enhance profitability.    Stakeholder Collaboration:    Support commercial decision-making through pricing analysis, campaign evaluation, and margin optimization    Support market initiatives, including business case development and performance tracking for new initiatives and channels    Process Improvement: Identify and implement improvements to financial processes, controls, and reporting systems to drive efficiency and enhance data integrity.Furthermore, you have:    Strong commercial acumen with the ability to drive profitability through pricing strategies, margin analysis, campaign follow-up, and business case evaluation across multiple brands or product lines.    Understanding of end-to-end value chains, including procurement, logistics, inventory management, and dealer/distribution networks, with the ability to identify risks and optimization opportunities.    Demonstrated ability to act as a strategic partner to senior stakeholders, influencing decision-making through data-driven insights and challenging the business constructively.    Advanced analytical capabilities and strong experience working with ERP and BI tools (e.g. SAP, Business Central, Power BI), with a focus on automation, data quality, and scalable reporting.    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English.    Experience in the automotive industry is a plus.Why work with usAs an employer, we are good at taking advantage of driven and committed employees. With us, there are many career paths to choose from – our attitude is that individuals with the right potential should be able to grow with us. We are responsible and ensure fair terms of employment, and all operations are covered by collective agreements. We care about our employees and see a long-term and sustainable working life as a strong competitive advantage. We offer a wide range of benefits such as advance vacation, extra parents' salary and a generous wellness allowance to protect our employees' health. Read more on our website www.hedinmobilitygroup.com

title: Fellowship in burn care
description: Verksamhetsområde plastik- och käkkirurgiVi är Akademiska sjukhuset – ett av Sveriges ledande universitetssjukhus. Som länssjukhus och leverantör av högspecialiserad vård erbjuder vi vård till två miljoner människor i Mellansverige. Här händer det ständigt något – ett nytt liv föds, en mormor opereras, en kollega hyllas som hjälte. Hos oss får du uppleva både hårda prövningar och fantastiska händelser, i en stark gemenskap med kollegor. Välkommen med din ansökan!The department of Plastic and Maxillofacial surgery offers 6- or 12-month fellowship in burn care. The period will be decided with the candidate that is offered the fellowship. The burn center is one of Sweden’s two national burn centers appointed by the Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare, for the care of severe burns. Annually approximately 150 patients are admitted to the center and approximately 1400 patients are seen at outpatient visits. The patients are treated in the center from the acute phase via intensive-, intermediate-, and ward care until discharge and subsequent outpatient care including follow-ups, rehabilitation and reconstructive surgery. All ages and all aspects of burn care are handled in the center. The fellowship program is an academic clinical program.Clinical ExposureDuring Burn Care Fellowship there is very close interaction with staff. The fellow will be involved in all aspects of patient care including active participation in intensive-, intermediate-, and ward care, preoperative surgical planning, operative procedures, outpatient clinics, and follow-up, rehabilitation and surgical reconstructions, always under supervision of the medical staff.The fellow will work in a team of 1-2 junior doctors, 1-2 plastic surgery specialists and 1-2 intensive care physicians and will participate in all aspects of burn care from the acute phase to outpatient follow-ups and reconstructions.Education and TeachingA large number of journal clubs, department conferences and one-on-one instructional sessions are an integral part of the Burn Care Fellowship Program. The fellow will actively participate in several multidisciplinary conferences, seminars and rounds at the Uppsala University Hospital.Literature resources in the libraries of the department, hospital, and Uppsala University are available for the fellow.Research OpportunitiesThe fellow is expected to pursue at least one research project of personal interest within the field of burn care under supervision of one of the senior consultants and is encouraged to finalize at least one publication.SalaryCompetitive salary and possibility for accommodation in Uppsala.RequirementsThe candidate must be specialist in plastic surgery or senior resident in plastic surgery with ambition to pursue a career in burn care and be able to work in a team.How to applySubmit your CV and two letters of recommendation. Recruitment is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline, so dont wait with your application.ContactRecruiting manager, Fredrik Huss, fredrik.huss@akademiska.se Facklig kontaktperson nås via Upplands Allmänna Läkarförening, kansli 018-611 34 95Vill du jobba med oss?Välkommen med din ansökan via länken nedan.Läs om anställningsvillkor och lönesättning inom Region Uppsala här: Bli vår nya kollega (https://regionuppsala.se/jobb-och-utbildning/bli-var-nya-kollega/)Region Uppsala värdesätter de kvaliteter som jämn könsfördelning och mångfald tillför verksamheten och ser gärna sökande av alla kön och med olika födelsebakgrund, funktionalitet och livserfarenhet.Region Uppsala krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal utifrån totalförsvarets behov. Detta innebär för den enskilda medarbetaren inga förpliktelser i fredstid utan är enkom en planeringsåtgärd.Inför beslut om anställning, sker kontroll av misstanke- och belastningsregister avseende samtliga arbetssökanden som i den sökta anställningen kan komma att arbeta inom psykiatrisk sjukvård, habilitering, vård av barn och ungdom eller tvångsvård av missbrukare, områden som omfattas av fakultativa registerutdrag. Detta gäller således alla som kommer att arbeta patientnära, även om arbetsuppgifterna i nuläget inte är tänkta att huvudsakligen innehålla arbete med ovan nämnda patientgrupper.Denna rekrytering sker helt genom Region Uppsalas försorg och vi undanber oss telefonsamtal från rekryteringsföretag och annonsförsäljare.

title: Manager Software Development
description: CompanyFlygprestanda AB has thanks to its leading expertise in the aviation industry for 57 years become one of the leading suppliers of takeoff and landing calculations for airlines worldwide. We are also in the forefront of developing new products and services in the aerospace industry.We are specialists in software and software related services to the airline's operational departments, where our software services are used by pilots to make takeoff and landing calculations prior to each flight. Since our customers use our services prior to each flight, they expect both high quality and flexible solutions.In fresh premises with an attractive location next to “Stortorget” in central Malmö we can offer a stimulating and challenging position as Manager Software DevelopmentProfileWe are looking for someone with comprehensive technical expertise from the Software Development Lifecycle, preferably back-end oriented, to enter the position as Manager for our Software Project Department. We believe that you are a dedicated problem solving individual, with a team-effort mind-set and a professional personality. You are thorough in your work and believe in organizing your day in a productive manner. You are also expected to have good skills in planning, project management and documentation.Work descriptionThis position reports to the Managing Director and is also member of the Management group.The area of responsibility includes planning of software development activities and team management. Working on and planning multiple projects is also part of the daily tasks and includes liaising with team members of different departments, such as Engineers, other Software Developers and Sales & Marketing Manager.The product portfolio consist of a variety of aircraft performance and flight planning related services and applications, aimed for pilots and dispatch centers.The Software Development teamWe are a small but dedicated team consisting of: Software Developers, Tester,Graphic Designer. A solution oriented mindset is a valuable asset in our daily work.You will be resonsible for (amongst responsibilities)- Responsible for hiring of personnel within the department.- Strategic service/product planning together with Management.- Plan and follow up on the software development Lifecycle overall.- Plan and follow up on the daily software development process (scrum).- Provide technical in-house expertise related to the software solutions developed.- Handle Software Development statistics.- DocumentationRequired skills- Fluent in English on a professional level. Also in writing.- Knowledge in project management.Favorable experience- Knowledge in aircraft performance and flight planning- Degree in Software Development.- Experience of Java, Javascript or other relevant programming languages.- Good knowledge in the Swedish language.ApplicationSend your CV and a personal letter to careers@flygp.se, not later than 17/12-2026.Note: This position may be appointed prior to above stated deadline.

title: Sales Support Representative
description: Sales Support RepresentativeHönö | Berg PropulsionSince 1912, Berg Propulsion has been developing technology that drives the global maritime industry forward. From our origins as a Swedish shipyard, we have grown into an international leader in marine propulsion systems, delivering propellers, thrusters, control systems, and hybrid-electric solutions to customers around the world.At our headquarters in Hönö, you'll find a very collaborative and welcoming work environment with short decision-making paths, high engagement, and a strong team spirit! Here, cutting-edge technology is combined with the genuine Berg culture—where collaboration, accountability, and continuous development are at the heart of everything we do.Are you our next Sales Support Representative?We are currently looking for a new colleague to join our Sales Support team. This is a fixed-term position with the possibility of a permanent contract after the first six months.As part of our team, you will play a key role in supporting the operational backbone of our aftermarket business. This position is ideal if you enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, thrive in a structured environment, and are energized by collaborating with others to ensure a smooth and efficient order process.We are a highly skilled and committed team who is known for its positive attitude and strong sense of collaboration. We support one another, share knowledge, and work together to find solutions—even when the pace is high!The RoleAs a Sales Support Representative, you will be responsible for ensuring that customer orders are handled efficiently and with a high level of quality—from handover by the Sales team through delivery and invoicing.You will act as a central point of coordination between several internal departments, ensuring that accurate information is maintained in our systems, deliveries are monitored, and any deviations are managed in a structured manner. The role is primarily an internal support function with many cross-functional contacts throughout the organization.We are also in an exciting phase of development, implementing new ways of working and improving our processes. Therefore, we are looking for someone who enjoys contributing ideas and sees continuous improvement as a natural part of everyday work.Key ResponsabilitiesIn this role, you will be responsible for:    Ensuring an efficient order flow from handover through delivery and invoicing.    Registering and administering customer orders in the ERP system.    Managing price adjustments and updating item master data.    Monitoring deliveries and handling deviations.    Coordinating daily activities with Production, Purchasing, Logistics, and other internal departments.    Managing returns and warranty claims.    Ensuring that information and documentation in our systems is accurate and up to date.You will have the authority to prioritize and reschedule orders, manage price updates, determine lead times in collaboration with the business, and independently handle standardized warranty and claims processes.QualificationsRequired    Upper secondary school diploma or equivalent.Preferred    Post-secondary education in Engineering, Logistics, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.Experience & SkillsWe believe you have:    Experience in Sales Support, After Sales, Order Management, or a similar coordination role.    Experience working with ERP systems and other business administration systems.    Excellent communication skills in both Swedish and English, spoken and written. Preferred    Experience working in a B2B environment.    Knowledge of spare parts, service processes, or technical products. Personal QualitiesWe place great emphasis on your personal qualities and believe you recognize yourself in the following:    Communicative – You build strong relationships, communicate clearly, and establish trust.    Structured and Detail-Oriented – You work methodically, stay organized, and maintain a high level of quality.    Service-Minded – You naturally enjoy supporting others and delivering excellent service.    Solution-Oriented – You focus on opportunities and find effective solutions to challenges.    Responsible and Proactive – You take ownership of your work, drive tasks forward, and actively contribute to improvements.Why join Berg Propulsion?At Berg Propulsion, you'll become part of a company where people enjoy their work and have the opportunity to grow. We offer a workplace by the sea, short decision-making paths, and a culture built on collaboration, support, and shared success.You will have a manager who leads with trust, encourages initiative, and supports your professional development as you grow in your role.To give you the best possible start, we provide a well-structured onboarding program. You will begin by learning about our products in our production environment before gradually being introduced to our systems, processes, and ways of working.We look forward to receiving your application!We will review all applications and contact selected candidates as soon as the recruitment process resumes.Thank you for your patience and we look forward reading your application!ContactAzaro Dominguez✉ azaro.dominguez@bergpropulsion.com

title: Data Engineer
description: JobbeskrivningWe’re looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines, develop scalable backend APIs, and improve the data solutions used across the team. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of trust, where you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work and drive improvements.The role requires working on-site at our client’s office in Malmö three days per week. BaskunskaperWhat you’ll do    Build and maintain data pipelines using Spark and Flink.    Develop and improve data solutions used across the team.    Build scalable backend APIs that make data accessible.    Provide technical support to colleagues on data engineering topics.    Drive initiatives and contribute to technical improvements.Who you areWe place great emphasis on personal qualities. You enjoy taking responsibility for your work and are comfortable working independently. You also enjoy collaborating, sharing knowledge, and supporting your colleagues.You approach challenges with curiosity and creativity, use your analytical skills to find solutions, and communicate your reasoning clearly and confidently when discussing technical decisions.What you bring    Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role.    Strong programming skills, including Python and either Java or Scala.    Solid backend development experience, for example with Scala Play or an equivalent framework.    A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field. A master’s degree is a strong advantage.    Excellent written and spoken English. Personliga färdigheter, egenskaper, erfarenhetIt’s an advantage if you have    Experience with Spark, Flink, or other big data tools.    Exposure to Iceberg, microservices running on Kubernetes, Snowflake, Kafka, or Akka.    Experience with visualization tools such as Grafana.    An interest in or hands-on experience with machine learning.

title: Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.What you’ll doAs the Project Controls Performance and Reporting Lead for Green Steel, you’ll bring together project information from Planning, Cost, Contracts, the EPCM contractor and other area teams. You’ll analyse this information to show how the project is performing, highlight trends and deviations, and provide clear reporting and recommendations to support decision-making.    Coordinate the collection, validation and integration of cost, contract, schedule, progress, quantity and resource information.    Analyse performance data to identify trends, variances, risks, opportunities and issues requiring action.    Prepare consolidated reports, dashboards and management summaries for the area.    Work with project teams and the EPCM contractor to align inputs and resolve gaps or discrepancies in reporting.    Follow up significant differences between reported progress and site execution, escalating issues where needed.    Support consistent project controls processes and reporting standards within the area.    Identify practical improvements to reporting, data quality and analysis, including opportunities to use automation and Power BI.    Provide technical guidance on integrated reporting and performance analysis, and support project reviews and assurance activities.What you’ll bringYou’re analytical and comfortable working across different project disciplines. You can bring complex project information together, identify what it means for performance, and explain your findings clearly to different stakeholders.    Relevant experience in project controls, cost control, contract or commercial controls, or project performance reporting in a complex project environment.    Experience consolidating and analysing information across areas such as cost, schedule, progress, contracts, quantities or resources.    Experience working with EPCM contractors and multidisciplinary project teams.    Strong skills in trend and variance analysis, forecasting, progress measurement, and identifying risks and opportunities.    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and relevant project controls systems.    Knowledge of project controls governance and practices such as AACE or PMI.    Ability to turn complex data into clear reports, insights and recommendations.    Professional written and verbal communication skills in English.    A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience. A project controls or cost management certification is an advantage.Benefits at StegraAt Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

title: Field Project Manager, Sweden
description: ROXON specializes in demanding bulk material handling solutions. We design and deliver conveyor systems, modernizations, maintenance services, and spare parts for material handling equipment. Our comprehensive solutions and world-class lifecycle support serve industries including mining, energy, pulp and paper, and process manufacturing. At ROXON, decades of engineering expertise meet innovation. Our success is built on the passion, dedication, and professional excellence of our people. Trust, technical expertise, and the capability to take on even the most challenging projects are the core values that drive our project business.We are now looking for a Field Project Manager to join our team in Malmfälten.As a Field Project Manager, you are responsible for ensuring successful project delivery from planning & designing through completion. Your role includes managing schedules, budgets, customer communication, and on-site activities while ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, and to the highest quality standards.You will lead equipment delivery and modernization projects, coordinate installation work and subcontractors, and act as the primary point of contact for customers throughout the project life cycle. The role requires close cooperation with sales, service, engineering, purchasing, and other internal teams to ensure smooth execution and excellent customer experience. You will support site operations when needed and promote a proactive, customer-focused, and solution-oriented way of working.Based in Gällivare, this position offers a hands-on opportunity to work with industrial and material handling projects in a dynamic mining environment, where strong leadership, practical problem-solving skills, and a "get things done" mindset are highly valued!Qualifications:- Technical understanding of mechanical systems, industrial equipment, conveyor technology, or material handling solutions /equipment- Strong leadership and coordination skills.- Ability to read and understand technical drawings.- Self-driven and capable of working independently while taking ownership of project activities, customer relationships, and business development initiatives.- Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills in both Swedish and English.- Willingness to travel frequently within Sweden; a valid driver's license is required.The ideal candidate is passionate about building long-term customer relationships, developing successful partner networks, and driving product performance and market growth. You thrive in a hands-on environment where you can combine strategic thinking with active customer engagement. The role can be tailored to match your skills, experience, and strengths.What We Offer:- A key role in growing a cutting-edge conveyor products in local markets.- The opportunity to take ownership of projects for a strategically important market area.- An international working environment within a strong global industrial group (NEPEAN).- Support from an experienced organization.Why join us?You'll become part of a growing team where attitude matters as much as experience. We offer training, responsibility, and the opportunity to make a real impact on customer success across Northern Sweden and Norway.Interested?Please submit your application in English by December 7, 2026, [via this link](https://ats.talentadore.com/apply/field-project-manager-sweden/ZlE0qd).Please note that we review applications and interview candidates throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.For further information about the position, please contact our recruitment partner: Liena Silen p. +358 40 482 6770 or liena.silen@eezy.fi and Saara Saalo +358 40 183 6260 or saara.saalo@eezy.fiROXON Sweden ABAt ROXON, we are committed to delivering solutions that are truly optimal for our customers' operations. We believe that honesty and transparency create something far more valuable than a few percentage points: trust.Rather than offering standard, one-size-fits-all solutions, we provide tailored systems built on strong process expertise and a deep understanding of each customer's unique needs. We take the time to understand our customers' challenges and evaluate different solution alternatives together with realistic implementation schedules.We call this approach the Nordic Way. It is built on continuous dialogue, close collaboration, and shared problem-solving with our customers.Phone: +358 40 482 6770 Location: Gällivare

title: Cyber Security Engineer  Vulnerability & Architecture (OT/IT)
description: Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come. Do you want to secure critical industrial operations where cyber security directly impacts safety, production, and sustainability?As a Cyber Security Engineer at Boliden, you will design and implement robust security solutions, reduce vulnerabilities, and safeguard both IT and OT environments. You will help ensure that production-critical systems are resilient, reliable, and built for the future.We look forward to receiving your application!Your opportunityIn this role, you will lead engineering- and architecture-driven risk reduction across complex IT and OT environments, with ownership of the vulnerability management capability and its evolution across tools, processes, and architecture.You will translate threat and vulnerability insights into architectural patterns, hardening strategies, and risk-based remediation roadmaps. Working closely with IT, OT, and business stakeholders, you will influence decisions and ensure security is embedded by design across initiatives and projects.As a key partner in cross-functional delivery, you will help steer initiatives from a security engineering perspective—balancing technical depth, pragmatism, and scalability—while collaborating with adjacent functions such as incident response, SOC, and threat intelligence.Who you will work withYou will report to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and play a key role within Boliden’s Group-wide security function, contributing to safeguarding our operations, people, and sustainable future through robust IT and information security.The position is preferably based in Stockholm or in Boliden but can also be located at any of our operational sites. title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com  Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Role Summary This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the way of handling new vehicle related legislation. We are responsible for overviewing and handling new legislation, coordinating the Technical Lobbyist network and making valid legislation available in the VW database Getex and also in the product structure OAS. We are part of the Domain Product Compliance within Modular Solutions.As a member of the Regulatory Affairs section, you will play a key role in handling new vehicle legislation from a global perspective. Working across areas such as Active Safety & ADAS, Digital Product Compliance, Electrification and Circularity, you will coordinate legislation activities across regions and collaborate with stakeholders from R&D, Public Affairs, Product Planning and external organizations.The role combines leading Regulatory Clusters, evaluating the impact of future legislation on products, supporting technical lobbying activities, and participating in international industry working groups related to vehicle legislation and compliance.You will be active in some suitable external working groups preferably in the field of Active Safety. Most of our external working group participation is in the global vehicle industry association OICA. This is also very much depending on your back ground and experience. Other working group participation could be discussed depending on your background.Job Responsibilities·      Lead (Pilot) the Regulatory Cluster working group for Active Safety & ADAS and provide input to the legal roadmap within these areas.·      Coordinate legislation-related activities with colleagues across Europe, Brazil, the US and China, including technical lobbyists, type approval engineers and subject matter experts.·      Drive process development and ensure Regulatory Affairs responsibilities are integrated into TRATON One PDP and Regulatory Affairs processes.·      Summarize Technical Lobbying Criticality and communicate relevant topics to TRATON Public Affairs when needed.·      Participate in external technical lobbying working groups, particularly within OICA GEVA and ACEA, focusing on automated, autonomous and connected vehicle regulations, CSMS/SUMS and related legislative developments.·      Monitor Active Safety and ADAS related regulations across Regulatory Clusters and working groups.·      Stay informed about company strategy, technology developments and legislative trends to proactively support stakeholders.Who You Are We believe you have:·      Experience in regulatory affairs topics and participation in external technical lobbying forums.·      Experience working within a product development process, with strong understanding of requirements management and Type Approval.·      Ability to transform improvement ideas into practical implementation.·      Experience evaluating and interpreting vehicle-related legislation.·      A relevant Engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.·      A structured way of working combined with high integrity and professionalism.·      Strong written and spoken English communication skills. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us. This Is Us We are a collaborative and skilled Regulatory Affairs section responsible for building the roadmap of upcoming legislation, identifying legal gaps, supporting efficient technical lobbying activities and ensuring vehicle-related legislation is available and accessible throughout TRATON R&D.We work closely with TRATON Group R&D, our brands, TRATON Public Affairs and TRATON Product Planning. Our mission is to identify legal gaps early, enable proactive product development activities and contribute to the establishment of effective, data-driven vehicle legislation. Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry. TRATON Offers With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje. Application We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-12-06. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Magnus Jalkesten, Head of Regulatory Affairs, magnus.jalkesten@scania.com We look forward to your application! This recruitment process is handled by Scania for TRATON Group R&D

description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Cuisinier·ère (F/H/D) - CDI - 50%---Cuisinier·ère (F/H/D) \- CDI \- 50%=====================================La Fondation Saphir, fondation multi\-missions et multi\-sites (psychogériatrie, gériatrie, psychiatrie adulte), est active dans le domaine médico\-social dans le canton de Vaud et dans l’accueil et l’accompagnement de personnes fragilisées dans leur intégrité physique et psychique au cours de leur processus de vie.Nous recherchons pour notre établissement l’EMS Contesse à Croy, qui accueille 36 Personnes et qui est spécialisédans le domaine de la gériatrie :Cuisinier·ère (F/H/D) \- CDI \- 50%=====================================En collaboration avec le chef de cuisine, vous assurez la préparation des repas et garantissez des prestations de restauration de qualité à la hauteur des besoins des Personnes. Vous êtes responsable de la bonne organisation et du bon fonctionnement de la cuisine et veillez au bon déroulement du service en salle. De plus vous participez activement aux manifestations de  l’établissement, aux projets d’accompagnement des Personnes en collaboration avec l’équipe interdisciplinaire et à l’intégration des nouveaux·lles professionnel·le·s, apprentis et stagiaires du service restauration.VOTRE PARCOURS \- VOS QUALITÉS ET COMPÉTENCES :* Vous êtes au bénéfice d’un CFC de cuisinier et avez une expériencce avérée dans le domaine social.  * On vous reconnait un sens des responsabilités et de l’organisation ainsi qu’une capacité à prioriser.  * L’esprit d’équipe, la remise en question et la communication font partie de vos qualités.  * La maitrise du français (oral \+ écrit) et une utilisation courante des outils informatiques sont des acquis pour vous.  NOUS VOUS OFFRONS* La possibilité de travailler dans un environnement riche de contacts.  * L’occasion de participer à des projets institutionnels novateurs.  * Des conditions de travail et salariales selon la CCT SAN (convention collective de travail du secteur sanitaire parapublic vaudois). Classe 10\-12 et selon expérience.  * L’opportunité de maintenir et développer vos compétences grâce à un programme de formations internes variées.   ENTRÉE EN FONCTION : Le 1er novembre 2026La protection de vos données personnelles est assurée selon la LPD. title: Responsable de salle
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable de salle --- Responsable de salle ==================== ### Introduction LES GALERIES 27 Holding SA crée des expériences inoubliables autour des plaisirs épicuriens, du bien\\-être et de l'art de vivre. Réparties sur six étages, nos activités offrent à nos clients un environnement où la qualité de l'accueil et du service occupe une place centrale. Nous recherchons un·e Responsable de salle pour coordonner le service et contribuer à une expérience client remarquable. ### Responsabilités Vous assurez le bon déroulement du service en salle et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes afin de maintenir un accueil fluide, attentif et professionnel. \* Organiser l'ouverture, la mise en place et la fermeture de la salle afin de garantir un espace prêt à accueillir les clients. \* Accueillir les clients, les accompagner et suivre leur expérience afin de répondre à leurs attentes avec attention. \* Coordonner le service en salle avec les équipes de cuisine et les autres interlocuteurs afin d'assurer une exécution efficace des prestations. \* Répartir les tâches et soutenir les collaborateurs pendant le service afin de maintenir la qualité et le rythme des opérations. \* Veiller au respect des standards de service, d'hygiène et de présentation afin de préserver une expérience cohérente et soignée. \* Gérer les demandes, remarques et situations imprévues des clients afin d'apporter des solutions rapides et adaptées. \* Transmettre les informations utiles à l'équipe et à la hiérarchie afin de faciliter la coordination et l'amélioration continue du service. ### Qualifications Nous recherchons une personne de terrain, attentive aux détails et capable de prendre des responsabilités dans un environnement orienté vers l'accueil et l'expérience client. \* Expérience dans la restauration, l'hôtellerie ou le service à la clientèle, avec une bonne compréhension des opérations de salle. \* Capacité à organiser les priorités, la mise en place et le déroulement d'un service. \* Aptitude à coordonner une équipe, à répartir les tâches et à collaborer avec différents interlocuteurs. \* Maîtrise des techniques d'accueil, de prise en charge des clients et de gestion des réclamations. \* Sens du service, présentation soignée et attention constante portée à la qualité de l'expérience client. \* Résistance au stress, réactivité et capacité à prendre des décisions dans les situations imprévues. \* Communication claire, esprit d'équipe et attitude professionnelle. ### Application Nous vous invitons à poser votre candidature directement via cette annonce. !\[LES GALERIES 27 Holding SA\]( ) \* LES GALERIES 27 Holding SA Grand Rue 27 1530 Payerne \* \[ \](\< \>) jpida1f2cf5jm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

title: Conseiller en prévoyance & planification financière
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Conseiller(ère) en prévoyance &amp; planification financière--- Conseiller(ère) en prévoyance \& planification financière============================================================Vous êtes passionné(e) par le conseil financier, animé(e) par l'esprit entrepreneurial et convaincu(e) que la qualité d'une relation client fait toute la différence ?Vous souhaitez évoluer dans une structure indépendante, dynamique et ambitieuse, où votre expertise est reconnue et où vous disposez des moyens nécessaires pour développer votre activité ?**Bienvenue chez DiLife \& co SA !**Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) **Conseiller(ère) en prévoyance \& planification financière** souhaitant s'investir durablement dans une aventure professionnelle et humaine.Qui sommes\-nous ?------------------de plus de 15 ans d'expérience dans le conseil et la planification financière, **DiLife \& co SA** accompagne ses clients dans la construction, l'optimisation et la sécurisation de leur avenir financier.Notre conviction est simple : un conseil de qualité repose sur l'expertise, l'écoute, la confiance et une vision à long terme.Aujourd'hui, DiLife \& co SA s'inscrit dans la dynamique d'**ARCADE PARTNERS**, un écosystème entrepreneurial réunissant plusieurs sociétés aux expertises complémentaires dans les domaines de la prévoyance, de la planification patrimoniale et des stratégies financières.Cette synergie nous permet de proposer une approche globale et des solutions adaptées aux besoins de chaque client.Nous plaçons également l'innovation au cœur de notre développement, notamment grâce à **Pillarum**, notre plateforme digitale dédiée à la prévoyance, conçue pour simplifier les démarches et améliorer l'efficacité du conseil.**Notre ambition : conjuguer l'excellence du conseil, la puissance des outils modernes et la richesse des relations humaines.**Vos missions------------Au\-delà d'un poste, nous vous proposons de devenir un véritable acteur du développement de DiLife \& co SA.Vos principales missions :* Développer et fidéliser un portefeuille de clients en privilégiant des relations durables et de qualité.* Réaliser des analyses de prévoyance et élaborer des stratégies financières personnalisées.* Accompagner vos clients sur les thématiques de la prévoyance professionnelle (LPP), du libre passage, du 3e pilier, de la retraite et de la planification patrimoniale.* Identifier les besoins de vos clients et leur proposer des solutions cohérentes avec leurs objectifs.* Assurer un suivi régulier et un accompagnement de qualité tout au long de leur parcours.* Participer activement à la croissance du cabinet et contribuer à sa dynamique collective.Chez DiLife \& co SA, nous ne recherchons pas simplement des profils commerciaux. **Nous recherchons des professionnels capables de développer leur activité tout en plaçant l'intérêt du client au centre de leurs décisions.**Votre profil------------**Formation et expérience*** Vous êtes titulaire d'une certification **AFA ou IAF**, ou êtes actuellement en cours Monteur lignes aériennes
=========================

Multinet Communication Romandie SA est une entreprise active ans le domaine des infrastructures de télécommunication, en forte croissance en Suisse romande.

Rejoins notre équipe et participe à la construction, à l'entretien et au développement de réseaux de télécommunication aériens. Tu interviens sur le terrain pour le montage, l'installation et la maintenance des lignes, en veillant au respect des normes de sécurité et de qualité. Un poste varié et technique pour une personne motivée, habile de ses mains et appréciant le travail en extérieur et en hauteur.

**🚩 Tes missions :**

* Localisation et réparation de pannes sur les lignes aériennes en cuivre.
* Réparation des câbles, des manchons et des points de distribution endommagés.
* Montage, démontage et remise en état des réseaux aériens.
* Intervention sur les poteaux, les façades et les systèmes de support.
* Mesures et des contrôles techniques sur les lignes en cuivre.

* Expérience dans la construction ou la maintenance de lignes aériennes en cuivre.
* Expérience dans la technologie du cuivre (par exemple xDSL et contrôle des lignes).
* Expérience dans le dépannage est un atout.
* Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, fiable et orientée vers les solutions.
* Disponibilité pour le service de piquet et les interventions en dehors des horaires habituels.
* Bonnes connaissances du français écrit et oral.
* Permis de conduire catégorie B.


 

**🚀 Ce que nous t’offrons :** 

* Une fonction au sein d'une entreprise TU Swisscom en pleine environnement jeune, dynamique, humain et stimulant.
* Des responsabilités variées et de réelles perspectives d'évolution.
* Des conditions d'emploi attractives et 7 semaines de vacances par an.

title: Responsable Gérance et Center Management
description: La Société coopérative Migros Vaud compte près de 3’200 collaborateurs et exploite aujourd’hui un réseau d’une soixantaine de magasins dans le canton. Son département Immobilier assure la gestion, la valorisation et le développement d’un patrimoine diversifié comprenant notamment des centres commerciaux, des surfaces commerciales et des immeubles de rendement. À la suite du départ du titulaire du poste, Migros Vaud souhaite confier la responsabilité de son service Gérance immobilière et Center Management à une nouvelle personne. L’enjeu sera à la fois d’en assurer la continuité, de reprendre la responsabilité de l'équipe et de la faire évoluer et d’accompagner un département appelé à jouer un rôle central au regard des ambitions de développement de la coopérative. title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique---Collaborateur\-trice scientifique=================================Vous aimeriez contribuer au développement du canton de Fribourg, avez l'esprit du service public, et cherchez un poste varié qui fait sens ? A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. A l'écoute, dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, l'administration cantonale, et ses établissements, sont au service de la population fribourgeoise.Collaborateur\-trice scientifique================================= **Qui sommes\-nous?**Enseignement, recherche, emplois, événements: l'Université de Fribourg est un espace d'innovations et un moteur important pour la vie économique et culturelle de la région. Elle attire des étudiant\-e\-s et des chercheur\-euse\-s en provenance de toute la Suisse et du monde entier, elle marque le quotidien de la cité bilingue de Fribourg, depuis sa fondation en 1889\.The Knowledge and Technology Transfer Service of the University of Fribourg supports researchers in industry collaborations, the protection and commercialization of research results, and the creation of spin\-offs. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**Nous misons sur la complémentarité des compétences et la variété des perspectives car c'est la diversité des parcours et des profils qui fait la force de l'Etat de Fribourg. Nous favorisons la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et les conditions de travail flexibles. Pour en savoir plus, suivez ce . **Vos missions**The position covers responsibilities currently associated with intellectual property and licensing, particularly for chemistry, physics and the humanities.* Evaluate inventions for patent protection and commercialization* Advise researchers on IP protection strategies* Conduct prior\-art searches and patentability analyses* Assess novelty, inventive step and patentable subject matter* Identify the essential technical features of inventions and contribute to initial patent claims* Coordinate patent applications with researchers and external patent attorneys* Identify licensing and valorization partners* Negotiate and manage license, research and collaboration agreements* Manage intellectual property and support early\-stage spin\-offs* Provide guidance and training to researchers on IP, commercialization, and industry engagement.* Build and maintain relationships with industry partners, innovation ecosystem stakeholders, and investors.  **What we offer**A varied and international working environment at the intersection of science, intellectual property and business. Flexible working hours, possibility of remote work, continuing education and good work\-life balance.Two\-year fixed\-term contract, renewable. **Profil souhaité*** You have a PhD in natural sciences, engineering or related discipline, in\-depth practical understanding of intellectual property, including prior\-art searches and patentability analyses, drafting initial patent claims and further development in collaboration with patent attorneys* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in technology evaluation, licensing and technology transfer in academia, industry, a startup company or a patent law firm* You are proactive, analytical, independent and comfortable working with researchers, companies and legal specialists. Strong organizational and project management abilities are your strengths* You have excellent communication stakeholder management skills and a professional command of English and either French or **Coordonnées des personnes de contact**Dr. Mozzetti Rohrseitz  Head of Knowledge and Technology Transfer     * Rue \- 13 1701 Fribourg*** Rue \- 13 1701 Fribourg**jid2af0f7djm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Banking Sector Coordinator & Key Account Manager - FS Markets
description: Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets===============================================================**Discover KPMG – Become part of our team**  With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose\-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.Banking Sector Coordinator \& Key Account Manager \- FS Markets===============================================================**Location:** Zurich  **Workload:** 100%  **Start Date:** As soon as possible* Sector \& Account Support: Support the Banking Sector Executive and priority account teams in delivering sector and account priorities, coordinating activities and ensuring effective follow\-through.* Pipeline \& Performance: Maintain an overview of Banking pipeline, revenue and key opportunities, prepare regular reporting and highlight relevant insights and developments.* Go\-to\-Market Content \& Enablement: Support the development of Banking propositions, materials and sector content, helping account teams translate priority topics into relevant client conversations.* Go\-to\-Market Execution: Coordinate Banking campaigns, events and market initiatives, working closely with business, Marketing and Markets teams to ensure focused execution.* Market \& Client Insights: Monitor Banking market developments, regulatory topics and client trends, translating these into relevant insights for sector and account teams.* Knowledge \& Community: Support communication and knowledge sharing across the Banking community, ensuring relevant sector, market and account information is easily accessible.* Account Management: Provide hands\-on account management for selected priority Banking accounts, supporting account planning, client meeting preparation and follow\-up, internal coordination and go\-to\-market activities.* Client Analysis \& Relationship Mapping: Prepare client and relationship analyses to help account teams understand existing relationships, identify gaps and prioritize areas for further development.**Your contribution to KPMG****This is what makes you successful*** University degree in business or a comparable field of study; fluent in English, and/or French would be a strong advantage* 3–6 years of relevant professional experience in Financial Services or Banking, with a background in Markets, account management, business development support, consulting, or a similar role.* understanding of the Banking sector and an interest in market, regulatory and client developments.* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the confidence to coordinate effectively with senior stakeholders, account teams and multidisciplinary teams.* Proactive and hands\-on, taking ownership of activities and driving them through to completion.* Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work with pipeline, revenue and account data and translate information into clear insights and high quality presentation materials* Interest in AI and practical knowledge of using AI tools to support research, analysis and day\-to\-day work.* Comfortably operating in a fast\-paced environment with changing priorities and a high level of interaction across the organization.**Your benefits**  **Unlock Your Potential**  We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future\-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open\-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.  **Mentoring and Networking**  At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.  From programs such as WoMentoring for early\-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.**Flexible Working**  With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.  **Additional Benefits**  Successful employees need top\-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility\-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half\-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.**Generous Parental Leave**  We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.  To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.**Inspired by Innovation**  At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.**An inclusive culture**  Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  **Questions? We're here for you**    Experienced Hire Recruiter  ![KPMG]()jidf40cd67jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: Portfolio Manager
employer: Brevan Howard Investment Products Limited, Saint-Hélier (Jersey), succursale de Genève
description: The Portfolio Manager is allocated a defined amount of Master Fund trading capital and is individually accountable for the profit and loss generated on it. The role holder owns the complete investment process, from research and idea generation through portfolio construction, execution, risk management and performance attribution. The specific markets and style vary by individual; the expectations below apply to every Portfolio Manager in the Master Fund. It is a principal risk\-taking position, not an analytical, advisory or support function: the Portfolio Manager makes the final investment decisions and bears direct responsibility for their outcome.**Investment Management*** Generate profits for the clients of the Brevan Howard Master Fund by trading the allocated capital on their behalf, within the pre\-agreed trading mandate.* Originate, research and develop macro investment ideas, building each thesis on fundamental, quantitative and technical analysis, with particular attention to central bank policy, growth and inflation dynamics and their transmission into global rates, FX, inflation, volatility and equity index markets.* Construct a portfolio sized to conviction, liquidity and correlation, selecting the instruments and structures (cash securities, futures, swaps, options and other OTC derivatives) that give the most asymmetric expression of each view.* Deploy capital through directional and relative value expressions as the market regime warrants, including balance\-sheet\-intensive trades where the opportunity justifies it. Flexibility of style and the ability to scale risk into a strong theme are expected of a Master Fund Portfolio Manager.* Regularly reassess that the portfolio reflects the intended market view, and restructure or exit positions when a thesis is invalidated.* Take hands\-on responsibility for execution, counterparty relationships and liquidity sourcing, and ensure that any execution delegated to a trade analyst or execution trader is correctly implemented.**Risk Management*** Operate at all times within the risk framework agreed with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management: capital allocation, VaR and stress limits, leverage and balance\-sheet limits, concentration and liquidity constraints, and the fund’s drawdown limits.* Manage live portfolio risk daily and intraday, for the role holder’s own book and for any allocation run by team members, actively managing drawdowns and demonstrating strict discipline in loss management.* Liaise with the risk management team who deliver risk reports, articulating positions, rationale and sensitivities clearly and responding to challenge.* Liaise with Treasury to ensure positions are properly funded and that collateral is placed effectively.* Improve and scale risk\-taking over time as the investment process is proven, in agreement with the Chief Investment Officer and Risk Management.**Performance, Monitoring and Reporting*** Monitor, attribute and explain daily, monthly and annual P\&L and risk, and articulate performance drivers clearly to the Chief Investment Officer, Risk Management and senior management.* Deliver a return commensurate with the capital allocated, at a quality of returns (information ratio, drawdown profile, consistency across market regimes) consistent with the Master Fund’s expectations.* Prepare periodic performance reports on a timely basis, monitor adherence to exchange and counterparty limits, ensure that all trading activity is appropriately allocated and accounted for, and maintain accurate records of the investment rationale for positions and decisions.**Contribution to the Fund and the Firm*** Contribute to the Master Fund’s investment dialogue, sharing views, data and expertise with the Chief Investment Officer, other Portfolio Managers and senior management in a collaborative manner.* Where leading a team, take full responsibility for the hiring, development, output and conduct of analysts, traders and sub\-portfolio managers, and maintain an ongoing commitment to their development.* Present periodically to the investment management committee and, where required, support the Client Partnership Group with current and prospective investors.**Governance, Compliance and Conduct**Operate at all times within the firm’s compliance policies, applicable regulatory requirements (including market abuse, conflicts of interest, best execution and personal account dealing rules) and the firm’s Code of Conduct; hold any regulatory certification the role requires in the relevant jurisdiction (for example the FCA Certification Regime in the UK); and act with integrity at all times.**WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:**Essential* A minim title: Global Account Senior Manager 100%
description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100%
**Start Date:** As soon as possible

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Understanding both the client's business agenda and KPMG services to enable leveraging the global KPMG network to connect our clients to the right people, ensuring that client needs are correctly identified, and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating global activities and knowledge transfer to ensure client needs are correctly identified and the best solutions and value are delivered
* Coordinating a global team of professionals and supporting their client interaction
* Closely collaborate with Global Client operations in Switzerland, US, UK, and APAC, ensuring that locations are actively engaged
* Guiding internal teams during the proposal, engagement contracting and onboarding process
* Managing selected client relationships with stakeholders (procurement, contracting, staff vetting, client resource needs, etc.)
* Manage KPMG Risk Management activities related to client and engagement acceptance
* Responsible for client and ad-hoc reporting, Annual Global account planning, Client service team planning and preparing for client meetings
* Ensuring regular reporting and marketing activities tailored to the needs of the relevant client stakeholders and keeping all internal key stakeholders updated with developments
* Organize client insights program / client-service reviews
* Influence without direct authority, frequently providing coaching and input to a high level of firm leadership



**This is what makes you successful**



* University degree at Bachelor's or Master's level in business administration, finance, economics or a related discipline.
* At least 6--8 years of relevant experience, including a minimum of three years in global account management, business development or complex programme management within Financial Services or professional services.
* Demonstrated experience managing a large, complex international client account, coordinating stakeholders and client-service teams across multiple countries, service lines and seniority levels.
* Proven track record supporting the full opportunity lifecycle, including account planning, pipeline management, proposal coordination, commercial development, contracting and client onboarding.
* Strong understanding of the Financial Services sector and the ability to translate a client's strategic priorities into concrete opportunities across a broad professional-services portfolio.
* Credibility and confidence working directly with senior executives, partners, procurement and risk stakeholders, with the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
* Exceptional programme-management discipline, with evidence of independently managing multiple concurrent workstreams, deadlines, governance requirements and executive-level deliverables.
* Excellent written and verbal English, including the ability to prepare high-quality executive presentations and client communications; Proficient German is an advantage
* Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.**Inspired by Innovation**  At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies\-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting\-edge tools and state\-of\-the\-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.**An inclusive culture**  Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW , Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like\-minded colleagues.  **Questions? We're here for you**    Experienced Hire Recruiter  ![KPMG]()jid2b75d34jm jit1147jm jiy26jm
